texts.一路由夏侯渊率向陈留推进。: Route One, commanded by Xiahou Yuan, advanced toward Chenliu.
texts.三路由于禁率沿黄河北岸行动，目标是截断博陵渡口的补给线。: The three routes, led by Yu Jin, operated along the north bank of the Yellow River, aiming to cut off the supply line to the Boling crossing.
texts.三路輕騎隊就近隱蔽駐點待機以便執行偵察任務。: The light cavalry detachments of the three routes concealed themselves and camped nearby on standby to carry out reconnaissance tasks.
texts.下令全城戒备：加固城门与哨卡，增设夜巡与烽火联络；调派精兵把守淮南径路并设伏要点: Ordered the whole city to be on guard: reinforce city gates and sentry posts, increase night patrols and beacon-fire communications; dispatch elite troops to guard the Huainan route and set ambush points; send scouts toward Xiao
texts.为保全主帅与天子（皇帝），在许昌预设三条撤退通道并配备专属护卫看守撤退路线。: To protect the commander and the Son of Heaven (the Emperor), preset three retreat routes in Xuchang and assign dedicated guards to watch the retreat paths.
texts.为弩手、步卒与骑兵在许昌制订轮换表与驻守班次并明确轮换时限执行规则。: For crossbowmen, infantry, and cavalry in Xuchang, draw up rotation schedules and guard shifts and clarify the time limits and enforcement rules for rotations.
texts.主要对策之一是整顿水军，包含修船、备件储备、编制调整与建立统一信号通信系统。: One main countermeasure was to reorganize the navy, including repairing ships, stocking spare parts, adjusting unit organization, and establishing a unified signaling and communications system.
texts.乐进向汉献帝报告三路侦骑已按命同时出发。: Yue Jin reported to Emperor Xian of Han that the three reconnaissance cavalry units had departed simultaneously as ordered.
texts.乐进吩咐若遇阻滞或计划变更要即刻返回向程昱回禀。: Yue Jin instructed that if impeded or if plans changed, they must immediately return and report to Cheng Yu.
texts.乐进命令取回徐庶的母亲的家书后要速来向程昱禀报。: Yue Jin ordered that after retrieving the family letter from Xu Shu's mother, they should quickly come and report to Cheng Yu.
texts.乐进嘱咐同行者在前往许昌城东隐处的路上保持警戒和小心。: Yue Jin urged his companions to remain vigilant and careful on the way to the hiding place east of Xuchang.
texts.乐进在现场做初验后当场封签封存徐母家书并护送回程昱处由程昱终验。: After an initial inspection on site, Yue Jin sealed and stored Xu Shu's mother's family letter on the spot and escorted it back to Cheng Yu for Cheng Yu's final inspection.
texts.乐进在许昌向张辽禀报:当前军情，并请示下一步部署。: Yue Jin reported the current military situation to Zhang Liao in Xuchang and asked for instructions on the next deployment.
texts.乐进在许昌向程昱回禀。: Yue Jin reported back to Cheng Yu in Xuchang.
texts.乐进指示遇敌时各侦骑队须即刻速报并连夜回奏给都督部与汉献帝。: Yue Jin instructed that upon encountering the enemy, each reconnaissance cavalry unit must immediately report and send overnight reports to the command headquarters and Emperor Xian of Han.
texts.乐进率一队轻骑出城侦察，该队实出一百骑。: Yue Jin led a light cavalry detachment out of the city to scout; that detachment actually comprised one hundred riders.
texts.乐进率约百骑从城中出发。: Yue Jin departed from the city with about one hundred riders.
texts.乐进督管许昌的粮草与军需。: Yue Jin supervised Xuchang's provisions and military supplies.
texts.乐进被指定负责点收所缴补给并保全补给相关证据，作为许昌后勤职责。: Yue Jin was assigned responsibility for inventorying the surrendered supplies and preserving evidence related to the supplies, as part of Xuchang's logistics duties.
texts.乐进被指定负责点收押运到都督部指定仓库的补给物资，并立账记录且报告预计援军到达时: Yue Jin was assigned responsibility for receiving and inspecting supplies transported to the command headquarters' designated warehouses, recording accounts, and reporting the expected arrival time of reinforcements.
texts.乐进要求如需外援或补给，各将详报所需兵数、物资来源与预计到援时间，以便都督部统筹: Yue Jin required that if external aid or supplies were needed, each general should report in detail the number of troops required, the source of supplies, and the expected time of arrival so the command headquarters could coordinate allocation.
texts.乐进规定报告回报频率为日出与日落各一次。: Yue Jin stipulated the reporting frequency as once at sunrise and once at sunset.
texts.乐进请各将呈报可用于巡逻与侦骑的兵数及这些部队的当前驻点位置。: Yue Jin asked each general to submit the number of troops available for patrols and reconnaissance cavalry and the current garrison locations of those units.
texts.乐进请各将呈报各队的粮饷与军器余量及存在的短缺项。: Yue Jin asked each general to report each unit's remaining rations and military equipment and any existing shortages.
texts.乐进请各将呈报各队联络官的姓名与驻点坐标或位置。: Yue Jin asked each general to report the names and garrison coordinates or locations of each unit's liaison officers.
texts.乐进请各将逐项呈报南门、北门、东门、西门及各营可出动的守城步卒数。: Yue Jin asked each general to itemize and report the number of garrison infantry available to deploy from the South Gate, North Gate, East Gate, West Gate, and each camp.
texts.乐进负责清点许昌的粮饷和军器并向夏侯惇报告缺额。: Yue Jin was responsible for inventorying Xuchang's rations and weapons and reporting deficits to Xiahou Dun.
texts.乐进负责点收所缴补给、立账并保全证据并速上奏都督部。: Yue Jin was responsible for receiving and inspecting surrendered supplies, making account records, preserving evidence, and promptly reporting up to the command headquarters.
texts.二路由乐进率向濮阳推进。: The second route, led by Yue Jin, advanced toward Puyang.
texts.于禁向汉献帝报告已按诏令清点许昌的军器和粮饷以稳军心。: Yu Jin reported to Emperor Xian of Han that, according to the imperial edict, Xuchang's weapons and rations had been inventoried to steady the troops' morale.
texts.于禁命令诸将速报可出动的守门兵与侦骑数量，以便立刻部署。: Yu Jin ordered the officers to quickly report the number of gate guards and scouting cavalry available so they could be deployed immediately.
texts.于禁命在许昌城内留五十名士兵作为预备并把守要点。: Yu Jin left fifty soldiers in Xuchang as a reserve and to guard key points.
texts.于禁在许昌下令加固许昌的城墙。: Yu Jin ordered the walls of Xuchang to be reinforced.
texts.于禁在许昌下令封固许昌的外门。: Yu Jin ordered Xuchang's outer gates to be sealed.
texts.于禁在许昌下令抽调轻骑分三路出城侦察，每路约一百骑，城内留五十骑为预备。: Yu Jin ordered light cavalry to be drawn into three routes to scout out of the city, about one hundred riders per route, leaving fifty riders in the city as a reserve.
texts.于禁在许昌下令昼夜轮换部署弩兵驻守城墙。: Yu Jin ordered crossbowmen to be deployed on the city walls in rotating day-and-night shifts.
texts.于禁在许昌下令采用程昱和荀彧提出的议策。: Yu Jin ordered that the strategies proposed by Cheng Yu and Xun Yu be adopted in Xuchang.
texts.于禁在许昌准许夏侯渊率三路轻骑出城侦察。: Yu Jin in Xuchang permitted Xiahou Yuan to lead three routes of light cavalry out of the city to scout.
texts.于禁在许昌向荀彧、程昱等谋臣与将领汇报当前军情。: Yu Jin in Xuchang reported the current military situation to advisers and commanders including Xun Yu and Cheng Yu.
texts.于禁在许昌命乐进速清点并守护军中粮草。: Yu Jin in Xuchang ordered Yue Jin to quickly count and guard the army's grain and supplies.
texts.于禁在许昌命夏侯惇督守城内外的卫兵。: Yu Jin in Xuchang ordered Xiahou Dun to oversee the guards inside and outside the city.
texts.于禁在许昌命荀彧与程昱负责暗中侦察并及时上报情报。: Yu Jin in Xuchang ordered Xun Yu and Cheng Yu to conduct covert reconnaissance and promptly report intelligence.
texts.于禁率约百骑从城中出发。: Yu Jin set out from the city with about a hundred riders.
texts.于禁致奏汉献帝，请示是否需派出外援。: Yu Jin submitted a memorial to Emperor Xian of Han asking whether outside reinforcements should be sent.
texts.于禁致奏汉献帝，请示是否需进一步调兵。: Yu Jin submitted a memorial to Emperor Xian of Han asking whether further troop movements were needed.
texts.于禁负责守卫许昌的北门。: Yu Jin was responsible for guarding Xuchang's north gate.
texts.从许褚确认赵云私呈情报的时刻起约十五分钟后，军队发动夜袭。: About fifteen minutes after Xu Chu confirmed the time Zhao Yun privately presented the intelligence, the army launched a night attack.
texts.伏皇后下令洛阳回报京中护卫是否已增派。: Empress Fu ordered Luoyang to report whether the capital's guards had been increased.
texts.伏皇后命人即刻派遣信使前往洛阳，查证董承是否谋反。: Empress Fu ordered someone to immediately dispatch a messenger to Luoyang to verify whether Dong Cheng was rebelling.
texts.伏皇后命令在京师增派护卫，确保汉献帝与伏皇后的家人在城中安全。: Empress Fu ordered additional guards in the capital to ensure Emperor Xian and Empress Fu's family were safe in the city.
texts.伏皇后命洛阳同时报出派往洛阳之信使现所处位置、预计抵达时间与路途状况。: Empress Fu ordered Luoyang to also report the current location, estimated arrival time, and route conditions of the messenger sent to Luoyang.
texts.伏皇后指示若派往洛阳的信使遇阻滞或险情，信使务必折返并回报伏皇后。: Empress Fu instructed that if the messenger to Luoyang encountered obstruction or danger, the messenger must turn back and report to Empress Fu.
texts.伏皇后要求洛阳若京中护卫已增派，详报护卫人数、驻地与统帅姓名。: Empress Fu requested that Luoyang, if the capital guards had been increased, report the number of guards, their garrison locations, and the commanders' names.
texts.作战出发信号规定为掩护首领低声清嗓三次。: The signal to begin the operation was designated as the covering leader quietly clearing his throat three times.
texts.侦察完成后，孙乾将回报夏侯惇部队的兵力规模、行进方向和补给线位置。: After reconnaissance, Sun Qian will report Xiahou Dun's unit's troop strength, marching direction, and the locations of its supply lines.
texts.侦察部队若遇敌或发现敌方补给线迹象，须立即向许昌指挥部速报。: If the reconnaissance unit encounters the enemy or discovers signs of enemy supply lines, it must immediately report to the Xuchang command.
texts.侦察部队遇有异动须即刻向许昌城内速报。: If the reconnaissance unit detects any unusual movement, it must immediately report to Xuchang city.
texts.侦察部队须每日晨暮各向许昌城内报告一次侦察情况。: Reconnaissance units must report their findings to Xuchang once each morning and once each evening daily.
texts.修订的防务表格确认三路侦骑布署照旧，第一路在陈留郊外高地由夏侯渊率领100骑。: The revised defense roster confirmed the three-route reconnaissance cavalry deployment remained: the first route was on the high ground outside Chenliu, led by Xiahou Yuan with 100 riders.
texts.修订的防务表格确认第三路在博陵渡口西北由于禁率领100骑。: The revised defense roster confirmed the third route was northwest of the Boling ferry crossing, led by Yu Jin with 100 riders.
texts.修订的防务表格确认第二路在濮陽南掩蔽林由乐进率领100骑。: The revised defense form confirms that the second route is led by Yue Jin with 100 cavalry in the sheltering woods south of Puyang.
texts.修订的防务表格要求各侦骑队配备联络官并在日出与日落时例行报告，遇敌即刻报告。: The revised defense form requires each scouting cavalry unit to be equipped with a liaison officer and to make routine reports at sunrise and sunset, and to report immediately if they encounter the enemy.
texts.修订的防务表格要求汉水、黄河与博陵等主要渡口配置水师与轻骑哨队，每处配备30至5: The revised defense form requires naval units and light cavalry pickets to be stationed at major river crossings such as the Han River, the Yellow River, and Boling, with 30 to 50 men at each location.
texts.修订的防务表格规定城内设精锐预备约40人，由夏侯惇督领并划定快速出动路线。: The revised defense form stipulates an elite reserve of about 40 men inside the city, commanded by Xiahou Dun, with designated rapid-deployment routes.
texts.修订的防务表格规定城垛每垛配备5名弩手并设立连络哨。: The revised defense form stipulates that each battlement should have 5 crossbowmen and establish communication sentries.
texts.修订的防务表格规定补给与缴获由联络官押运至都督部指定仓库。: The revised defense form stipulates that supplies and captured goods are to be escorted by liaison officers to the command headquarters' designated warehouse.
texts.先决条件之一：张飞必须明示出发确切时间并承诺速取速归、不缠斗。: Prerequisite one: Zhang Fei must explicitly state the exact departure time and commit to a quick in-and-out operation, not to become entangled in prolonged fighting.
texts.先决条件之一：许褚需所派十名精兵准时到位，并能与赵云一方先遣联络，张勇负责接应这: Prerequisite one: Xu Chu must have the ten elite soldiers he assigns arrive on time and be able to liaise with Zhao Yun's vanguard; Zhang Yong is responsible for receiving and supporting these elite soldiers.
texts.先决条件之一：诸葛亮与城内当局必须保证夜袭期间后方戒备、收容与救援的准备就绪。: Prerequisite one: Zhuge Liang and the city authorities must ensure rear guard, shelter, and rescue preparations are ready during the night raid.
texts.关羽亲自统领押运队，负责押运自仓甲运出的首批300石粮食。: Guan Yu personally commands the escort team responsible for transporting the first 300 shi of grain sent from Warehouse A.
texts.关羽亲自统领的押运队配备100名护卫，并另派20名轻骑先行探路，押运队出发暂定为: Guan Yu's escort team is equipped with 100 guards and dispatches 20 light cavalry as advance scouts; the escort's departure is tentatively set for ten minutes later.
texts.关羽启动粮草封存工作，要求逐仓记录封存数量与护库人名。: Guan Yu initiates grain sealing procedures, requiring per-warehouse records of sealed quantities and the names of the guards of the storehouses.
texts.关羽命令孙乾与糜竺在盘点单到孙乾或糜竺手后十五分钟内上报逐项精确数字（单位/日耗: Guan Yu orders Sun Qian and Mi Zhu to report, within 15 minutes after an inventory list reaches either Sun Qian or Mi Zhu, the precise itemized numbers (units / daily consumption / number equipable), the store managers, and allocations.
texts.关羽命令孙乾与糜竺在盘点单到孙乾或糜竺手后十分钟内回报初报。: Guan Yu orders Sun Qian and Mi Zhu to return an initial report within 10 minutes after an inventory list reaches either of them.
texts.关羽命令机动骚扰队首批约120人即刻出城，轮换计划为每五分钟一班。: Guan Yu orders the first contingent of the mobile harassment squad, about 120 men, to leave the city immediately, with a rotation plan of a shift every five minutes.
texts.关羽在樊城向刘备、糜竺、孙乾提交了初步军事与后勤报告。: In Fancheng, Guan Yu submitted a preliminary military and logistical report to Liu Bei, Mi Zhu, and Sun Qian.
texts.关羽在樊城向刘备回报并确认分工。: In Fancheng, Guan Yu reported to Liu Bei and confirmed the division of labor.
texts.关羽在樊城城中率领一支机动骚扰队出城。: Guan Yu led a mobile harassment squad out of the city in Fancheng.
texts.关羽在樊城点定关平为机动骚扰队副将。: Guan Yu appointed Guan Ping as deputy general of the mobile harassment squad in Fancheng.
texts.关羽在樊城点定周仓为机动骚扰队队长。: Guan Yu appointed Zhou Cang as captain of the mobile harassment squad in Fancheng.
texts.关羽在樊城率领一支机动骚扰队，周仓任队长，关平任副将，该机动骚扰队已出城。: Guan Yu led a mobile harassment squad in Fancheng with Zhou Cang as captain and Guan Ping as deputy; the squad has left the city.
texts.关羽在樊城的军议上向刘备、糜竺、孙乾及众将建议以守为主、稳固后方并尽力拖延敌军。: At the military council in Fancheng, Guan Yu advised Liu Bei, Mi Zhu, Sun Qian, and the other generals to prioritize defense, secure the rear, and do their best to delay the enemy.
texts.关羽在樊城的军议上建议从现有甲胄武器中挑选约百余精锐组成机动队。: At the military council in Fancheng, Guan Yu suggested selecting about a hundred elite soldiers from the available armor and weapons to form a mobile unit.
texts.关羽在樊城的军议上建议加固城门、壕沟与弩楼以增强防守。: At the military council in Fancheng, Guan Yu suggested reinforcing the city gates, the moat, and the crossbow towers to strengthen the defense.
texts.关羽在樊城的军议上建议封存并保护粮草，优先保证士卒一个月口粮与兵饷。: At the military council in Fancheng, Guan Yu suggested sealing and protecting the grain supplies, prioritizing one month's rations and soldiers' pay.
texts.关羽在樊城的军议上建议明确护卫与管库负责人的名单以防内外窜动与失窃。: At the military council in Fancheng, Guan Yu suggested clearly listing the names of the guards and storekeepers to prevent internal and external tampering and theft.
texts.关羽在樊城的军议上建议立刻抽轻骑10至20人出城侦察并牵制敌军、断敌粮道。: At the military council in Fancheng, Guan Yu suggested immediately dispatching 10 to 20 light cavalry out of the city to scout, fix the enemy in place, and cut the enemy's supply routes.
texts.关羽在樊城的军议上建议立即疏散非战斗人员并加强重要粮仓的防护。: At the military council in Fancheng, Guan Yu suggested immediately evacuating non-combatants and strengthening protection of the important granaries.
texts.关羽在樊城的军议上建议该机动队昼夜骚扰敌侧翼，避免与敌主力正面决战。: At the military council in Fancheng, Guan Yu suggested that the mobile unit harass the enemy's flanks day and night and avoid a frontal battle with the enemy main force.
texts.关羽在樊城的军议上责令孙乾速派轻骑出城侦察并在完成后回报侦察结果。: At the military council in Fancheng, Guan Yu ordered Sun Qian to quickly send light cavalry out to scout and to report back the scouting results upon completion.
texts.关羽在樊城请求糜竺当面提交逐仓签字原件、府主簿与首批拟拨款明细。: Guan Yu in Fancheng requested Mi Zhu to personally present the original per-warehouse signed documents, the prefectural clerk, and the detailed list of the first proposed disbursements.
texts.关羽在该方案中拟自仓甲外运300石粮食。: In that plan, Guan Yu proposed to move 300 shi of grain out of Warehouse A.
texts.关羽在该方案中规定护送部队以100人为一队编成护送。: Guan Yu's plan stipulated that escorting units be formed in teams of 100 men.
texts.关羽将派100名护卫并亲率20骑轻骑先行侦察路线。: Guan Yu will dispatch 100 guards and personally lead 20 light cavalry to scout the route ahead.
texts.关羽已动用府库临时拨银以保障一月口粮与兵饷。: Guan Yu has used temporary silver from the prefectural treasury to guarantee one month's rations and soldiers' pay.
texts.关羽拟在十分钟后从樊城出发实施该外运行动。: Guan Yu planned to depart from Fancheng in ten minutes to carry out the transport operation.
texts.关羽指定孙乾负责呈交令仓曹逐项盘点单并统筹护送与侦察事务。: Guan Yu designated Sun Qian to deliver the warehouse officer's itemized inventory sheets and to coordinate escort and reconnaissance affairs.
texts.关羽指定糜竺负责收数、封存粮草并监督临时拨付一月口粮与兵饷。: Guan Yu designated Mi Zhu to tally counts, seal the grain and forage, and supervise the temporary disbursement of one month's rations and soldiers' pay.
texts.关羽派出20名骑兵前探，为护送刘备准许外运的首批300石粮侦查和探路。: Guan Yu sent out 20 cavalry to scout and reconnoiter the route for escorting the first batch of 300 shi of grain that Liu Bei permitted to be moved out.
texts.关羽要求孙乾在出城侦察时配属10到20名轻骑。: Guan Yu required Sun Qian to assign 10 to 20 light cavalry when scouting outside the city.
texts.关羽要求孙乾在短途呈交时安排5到10人护卫。: Guan Yu required Sun Qian to arrange 5 to 10 men as guards for short-distance deliveries.
texts.关羽规定如需长途护送，孙乾每队须配备至少100人。: Guan Yu stipulated that for long-distance escorts, Sun Qian's each team must be equipped with at least 100 men.
texts.关羽请孙乾尽速报告盘点单到达时刻、首批征粮拟行路线及所需护送兵力，以便立即安排装: Guan Yu asked Sun Qian to report promptly the arrival time of the inventory list, the intended route for the first conscripted grain, and the escort force required so loading and escort assignments could be arranged immediately.
texts.关羽请求孙乾确认盘点单到达的确切时间并确认可行路线。: Guan Yu asked Sun Qian to confirm the exact arrival time of the inventory list and to verify feasible routes.
texts.关羽负责指挥轻骑侦察、粮仓护卫并挑选百余精锐组建机动骚扰队护送最紧急物资。: Guan Yu was responsible for commanding light cavalry reconnaissance, guarding the granaries, and selecting over one hundred elite troops to form a mobile harassment unit to escort the most urgent supplies.
texts.其他需署之副將與守備席位預留若干，待孫策裁決或由張昭即行薦介。: Several deputy-general and garrison posts were to be reserved, awaiting Sun Ce's decision or to be immediately recommended by Zhang Zhao.
texts.出发信号由许褚或掩护首领张勇以低声清嗓三次发出。: The departure signal was to be given by Xu Chu or by cover leader Zhang Yong by softly clearing their throat three times.
texts.出发前，命侦察队向张辽与夏侯惇禀报已整编完毕并报告各路首领姓名。: Before departure, the reconnaissance team was ordered to report to Zhang Liao and Xiahou Dun that they had finished reorganizing and to report the names of each route leader.
texts.刘协命令乐进清点许昌的军器和粮饷。: Liu Xie ordered Yue Jin to inventory Xuchang's weapons and rations.
texts.刘协命令加固许昌的城墙。: Liu Xie ordered the walls of Xuchang to be reinforced.
texts.刘协命令即刻封固许昌的外门。: Liu Xie ordered the outer gates of Xuchang to be sealed immediately.
texts.刘协命令在许昌昼夜轮换部署弩兵。: Liu Xie ordered crossbowmen to be deployed in day-and-night rotations in Xuchang.
texts.刘协命令抽调轻骑分三路从许昌出城侦察。: Liu Xie ordered light cavalry to be detached in three routes to scout out from Xuchang.
texts.刘协规定夏侯渊的部队平时回报频率为每日晨报各一次、暮报各一次。: Liu Xie stipulated that Xiahou Yuan's unit should report in peacetime with one morning report and one evening report each day.
texts.刘备下令孙乾随使携带底线书函向江东请求立即援粮4000石，或分批供应以使樊城粮储: Liu Bei ordered Sun Qian, as accompanying envoy, to carry a written letter to Jiangdong requesting immediate grain aid of 4,000 shi, or supply in batches so that Fancheng's grain reserves would reach one month's supply.
texts.刘备命关羽列出机动队长与副将名单，并列出各粮仓护卫及管库人员名单。: Liu Bei ordered Guan Yu to list the mobile unit captains and deputy generals, and to list the guards for each granary and the storehouse managers.
texts.刘备命孙乾向江东请求至少一个月的兵饷，并请求若干牵制部队及水师支援。: Liu Bei ordered Sun Qian to request from Jiangdong at least one month's soldiers' pay and to request several blocking troops and naval support.
texts.刘备命孙乾指示该轻骑拟定护送路线并估算护送所需兵力。: Liu Bei ordered Sun Qian to instruct the light cavalry to draft escort routes and to estimate the escort troops required.
texts.刘备命孙乾派出10至20名轻骑出城侦察夏侯惇的行军方向。: Liu Bei ordered Sun Qian to dispatch 10 to 20 light cavalry out of the city to scout Xiahou Dun's marching direction.
texts.刘备命糜竺与府库主簿共同监督拨付并留账，负责军粮与兵饷的发放和记账。: Liu Bei ordered Mi Zhu and the prefectural clerk to jointly supervise disbursement and keep accounts; they were responsible for distribution and accounting of military grain and soldiers' pay.
texts.刘备命糜竺临时从府库拨出款粮，保障全军一月口粮与兵饷。: Liu Bei ordered Mi Zhu to temporarily draw funds and grain from the government treasury to secure one month's rations and soldiers' pay for the entire army.
texts.刘备命糜竺亲自当面向刘备汇报樊城的军需状况。: Liu Bei ordered Mi Zhu to personally report to him, in person, the military supply status of Fancheng.
texts.刘备在樊城下令准许自仓甲先行外运300石粮食。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered permission to begin transporting 300 shi of grain from the Cangjia granary.
texts.刘备在樊城下令孙乾即刻派轻骑10至20人出城侦察夏侯惇的行军方向，并回报敌军兵力: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered Sun Qian to immediately send 10 to 20 light cavalry out of the city to scout Xiahou Dun's marching direction and report back the enemy's force, march direction, supply lines, and requirements.
texts.刘备在樊城下令，命关羽将各粮仓护卫与管库人员名单呈上。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered Guan Yu to present the list of guards and warehouse managers for each granary.
texts.刘备在樊城下令，命关羽挑选百余精锐为机动骚扰队，昼夜扰敌侧翼。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered Guan Yu to select over one hundred elite troops as a mobile harassment unit to harass the enemy's flanks day and night.
texts.刘备在樊城下令，命关羽督促加固城门壕沟与弩楼。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered Guan Yu to supervise the reinforcement of the city gates, moats, and crossbow towers.
texts.刘备在樊城下令，命关羽组织非战斗人员疏散。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered Guan Yu to organize the evacuation of noncombatants.
texts.刘备在樊城下令，命孙乾立刻将逐项盘点单呈上仓曹，盘点单须注明每项数量、单位、日耗: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered Sun Qian to immediately present the itemized inventory list to the warehouse officer; the inventory must indicate each item's quantity, unit, daily consumption, number usable or equipable, and the warehouse managers and disbursements.
texts.刘备在樊城下令，命糜竺与府主簿共同监督银钱拨付。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered Mi Zhu and the prefectural registrar to jointly supervise the disbursement of money.
texts.刘备在樊城下令，指示侦察中如能断开夏侯惇补给，即可牵制其补给线。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered that during reconnaissance, if Xiahou Dun's supplies could be cut off, his supply line should be interdicted.
texts.刘备在樊城下令，表示在逐项盘点单到手后他将详阅再下下一步命令。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered that after he received the itemized inventory list, he would examine it in detail before issuing the next orders.
texts.刘备在樊城下令，要求各项在十分钟内回报初报。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered that initial reports on each item be returned within ten minutes.
texts.刘备在樊城下令，要求立刻封存现有粮草，封存时仓曹与孙乾当面签字并列出护库人员名单: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered the immediate sealing of existing grain and forage; when sealed the warehouse officer and Sun Qian must sign in person and list the names of the store guards.
texts.刘备在樊城准许孙乾即刻派快马携行书与一名使节前往江东试探孙权，随行护卫五至十骑。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei permitted Sun Qian to immediately dispatch a fast horse carrying a written letter and one envoy to Jiangdong to probe Sun Quan, with an escort of five to ten riders.
texts.刘备在樊城召集关羽、糜竺、孙乾等人，商议曹操命夏侯惇率十万兵直逼新野的情报与应对: At Fancheng, Liu Bei summoned Guan Yu, Mi Zhu, Sun Qian, and others to discuss the intelligence that Cao Cao ordered Xiahou Dun to lead 100,000 troops to directly advance on Xinye and to plan responses.
texts.刘备在樊城命令关羽派20名轻骑兵为押运队伍前探。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered Guan Yu to send 20 light cavalry as advance scouts for the transport convoy.
texts.刘备在樊城命令关羽率100名护卫押运那300石粮食。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered Guan Yu to lead 100 guards to escort the transport of those 300 shi of grain.
texts.刘备在樊城命令孙乾在出发前报告出发时刻、路线与随行兵数。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered Sun Qian to report the departure time, route, and number of accompanying soldiers before setting out.
texts.刘备在樊城命令孙乾当面向刘备呈交逐项盘点单。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered Sun Qian to hand the itemized inventory list to Liu Bei in person.
texts.刘备在樊城命令孙乾当面呈交仓库盘点原件并报告首批外运拟行路线与护送兵力。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered Sun Qian to present the original warehouse inventory sheets in person and report the planned route for the first batch to be transported and the escorting force.
texts.刘备在樊城命令孙乾的使节由5至10名骑兵护卫。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered that Sun Qian's envoy be guarded by 5 to 10 cavalry.
texts.刘备在樊城命令此次试探行程不得妨碍城内的盘点與侦察要务。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered that this probing mission must not interfere with the city's inventory and reconnaissance duties.
texts.刘备在樊城命令糜竺当面提交逐仓签字原件并报出府主簿姓名与首批拟拨款明细。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered Mi Zhu to present the original signed per-warehouse documents in person and to report the name of the prefectural registrar and the detailed items of the first proposed disbursements.
texts.刘备在樊城将押运队的出发时间暂定为十分钟后。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei tentatively set the departure time of the transport convoy for ten minutes later.
texts.刘备在樊城授权临时动用府库优先拨付樊城部队一个月口粮与兵饷。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei authorized the temporary use of the treasury to prioritize disbursing one month's rations and soldiers' pay to the Fancheng garrison.
texts.刘备在樊城明确外交探询不得妨碍樊城的盘点与补给要务。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei made clear that diplomatic inquiries must not impede Fancheng's inventory and supply duties.
texts.刘备差遣赵云到新野进行探查。: Liu Bei dispatched Zhao Yun to Xinye to conduct reconnaissance.
texts.刘备当场命糜竺向樊城上报军需情况，包括粮草、粮仓存量、武器与甲胄、弹药和兵饷，以: Liu Bei ordered on the spot that Mi Zhu report to Fancheng the military needs, including grain and forage, granary stock levels, weapons and armor, ammunition, and soldiers' pay, to allow for overall coordination.
texts.刘备臣，屡次捐资助军。: Liu Bei's minister repeatedly donated funds to support the army.
texts.刘备责成糜竺、孙乾與关羽等人在十分钟内回报初步情况。: Liu Bei ordered Mi Zhu, Sun Qian, Guan Yu, and others to report preliminary situation within ten minutes.
texts.初稿列明三路出城侦察路线与各驻点坐标。: The initial draft lists three routes for exiting the city for reconnaissance and the coordinates of each stationed point.
texts.初稿列明关键渡口识别与水险封控措施。: The initial draft lists identification of key ferry crossings and measures to control water hazards.
texts.初稿列明内城隘口防守安排、40人精锐预备队及其机动路径。: The initial draft lists defense arrangements for inner-city chokepoints, a 40-man elite reserve, and its mobility routes.
texts.初稿列明增援触发条件与优先调动时机。: The initial draft lists reinforcement trigger conditions and priorities for when to mobilize.
texts.初稿列明外壕每里哨点设置与夜间巡逻制度。: The initial draft lists sentry posts every li along the outer moat and the nighttime patrol system.
texts.初稿对陈留与汝南护运通道和伏兵埋伏安排做了部署。: The initial draft deployed escort channels for Chenliu and Runan and arrangements for ambush troops.
texts.初稿规定联络官职责并要求日出日落例报与遇敌速报制度。: The initial draft defines liaison officers' duties and requires routine reports at sunrise and sunset and immediate reports upon encountering the enemy.
texts.到位后，由张勇或许褚当场核验赵云私下呈报的情报。: Upon arrival, Zhang Yong or Xu Chu will verify on the spot the intelligence Zhao Yun privately submitted.
texts.到港时每艘船舶由周瑜方逐船清点照验并在登记台登记物资与匠人名单。: Upon arrival at port, each ship will be counted and inspected one by one by Zhou Yu's men, and supplies and the list of craftsmen will be registered at the registration desk.
texts.发动夜袭的前提是许褚所派十名精兵到位并经许褚或掩护首领张勇确认。: The precondition for launching a night raid is that the ten elite soldiers dispatched by Xu Chu are in position and confirmed by Xu Chu or the covering leader Zhang Yong.
texts.各路联络官负责将所缴补给押运至都督部指定仓库。: Each route's liaison officers are responsible for escorting the delivered supplies to the warehouse designated by the command headquarters.
texts.各部在许昌清点军器与粮饷，并向指挥部上报可出动兵数及巡逻、侦骑配备。: All units in Xuchang will inventory weapons and rations and report to the command the number of troops available for deployment and the allocation of patrols and scouting cavalry.
texts.周瑜下令优先修复80艘小舢板与10艘主战船。: Zhou Yu ordered prioritizing the repair of 80 small sampans and 10 main warships.
texts.周瑜下令列出所有待修舰船并集中调配修复所需材料。: Zhou Yu ordered listing all ships awaiting repair and centralizing the allocation of materials needed for repairs.
texts.周瑜下令集中保管油脂与燃器材，并指派轮值看守人员。: Zhou Yu ordered centralized storage of oil and incendiary/fuel materials and assigned personnel on rotational guard duty.
texts.周瑜命令各修缮班与水军营每日黄昏前汇总并呈报修复與操练情况。: Zhou Yu ordered each repair team and naval battalion to compile and submit daily, before dusk, reports on repairs and drills.
texts.周瑜在奏折中命令信使将奏折速送到建业。: In his memorial, Zhou Yu ordered the messenger to send the memorial promptly to Jianye.
texts.周瑜在奏折中详列了江夏水师当前的缺损情况。: In the memorial, Zhou Yu detailed the current deficiencies of the Jiangxia naval force.
texts.周瑜在奏折中请求孙权安排增援兵力到江夏。: In the memorial, Zhou Yu requested Sun Quan to arrange reinforcements to Jiangxia.
texts.周瑜在奏折中请求孙权派遣工匠到江夏修缮舰船。: In the memorial, Zhou Yu requested Sun Quan to send craftsmen to Jiangxia to repair ships.
texts.周瑜在奏折中请求孙权调拨官船与物资到江夏。: In the memorial, Zhou Yu requested Sun Quan to allocate official ships and supplies to Jiangxia.
texts.周瑜在奏折中请求孙权速派官船、匠人、物资与增援兵力，并请求孙权尽速回覆。: In the memorial, Zhou Yu requested Sun Quan to quickly dispatch official ships, artisans, supplies, and reinforcements, and asked Sun Quan to reply as soon as possible.
texts.周瑜在江夏命令水军持续操练，并演练夜间火攻与舰队协同战术以提高作战能力。: In Jiangxia, Zhou Yu ordered the navy to continue drills and to practice nighttime fire attacks and fleet coordination tactics to improve combat capability.
texts.周瑜在江夏安排水军进行近岸操练以提升战备。: In Jiangxia, Zhou Yu arranged for the navy to conduct near-shore exercises to improve readiness.
texts.周瑜在江夏审阅了当天的修复与操练详报并下达了相关命令。: In Jiangxia, Zhou Yu reviewed the day's detailed reports on repairs and drills and issued related orders.
texts.周瑜在江夏成立修缮班次，并为修缮人员配给粮饷与工具以维持长期修复工作。: In Jiangxia, Zhou Yu established repair shifts and allocated rations and tools to repair personnel to sustain long-term repair work.
texts.周瑜在江夏指定主码头、次码头与临时泊位用于接应与卸载。: In Jiangxia, Zhou Yu designated a main pier, a secondary pier, and temporary berths for receiving and unloading.
texts.周瑜在江夏检查并检修了水师的橹桨与系泊桩。: In Jiangxia, Zhou Yu inspected and overhauled the navy's oars and mooring piles.
texts.周瑜在江夏派遣信使携奏折与补给清单日夜兼程前往建业，委以护卫并嘱速回报。: In Jiangxia, Zhou Yu dispatched a messenger carrying the memorial and the supply list to travel day and night to Jianye, entrusted with escort and instructed to report back promptly.
texts.周瑜在江夏督察江夏水师并清点了所有战船与船员。: Zhou Yu inspected the Jiangxia naval forces at Jiangxia and took inventory of all warships and crew.
texts.周瑜在江夏组织临时修缮工程，面向当地征集匠人和木料。: Zhou Yu organized temporary repair works in Jiangxia, recruiting local craftsmen and timber.
texts.周瑜在江夏草拟并上呈给孙权一份奏折。: Zhou Yu drafted and submitted a memorial to Sun Quan in Jiangxia.
texts.周瑜在江夏试验使用油脂和燃烧器材进行火攻演练。: Zhou Yu experimented with using oil and incendiary devices for fire-attack drills in Jiangxia.
texts.周瑜增派两组匠人夜间加班，并配给两组匠人粮饷与修理工具。: Zhou Yu dispatched two additional teams of craftsmen to work night shifts and supplied those two teams with rations and repair tools.
texts.周瑜建立轮值守望制度和急号通报程序以维持码头秩序与安全。: Zhou Yu established a rotating watch system and an alarm-reporting procedure to maintain dock order and security.
texts.周瑜派遣信使携奏折與补给清单日夜兼程赴建业，将紧急请求送交孙权。: Zhou Yu sent messengers with a memorial and a supply list, making day-and-night haste to Jianye to deliver an urgent request to Sun Quan.
texts.周瑜督促两名信使连夜探报建业来官船及物资调发的预计到达时间。: Zhou Yu urged two messengers to make an overnight reconnaissance of the expected arrival times of incoming official ships and supply dispatches from Jianye.
texts.周瑜要求到货当日黄昏前汇总所有到货情况并上呈建业当局。: Zhou Yu required that all arrivals be summarized and presented to the Jianye authorities before dusk on the day of arrival.
texts.周瑜要求匠人按到达批次分批进入卸载区，优先投入可立即上阵的舰船修缮。: Zhou Yu ordered craftsmen to enter the unloading area in batches according to arrival batches, prioritizing repairs on ships that could be immediately deployed.
texts.周瑜规定按先到先卸，由周瑜方官员现场分配卸货顺序。: Zhou Yu stipulated first-come, first-unloaded, with Zhou Yu's officers on site assigning the unloading order.
texts.周瑜规定若发现物资损耗或短缺，周瑜方即刻通报建业当局追责并要求补发。: Zhou Yu stipulated that if material loss or shortages were discovered, Zhou Yu's side would immediately notify the Jianye authorities to hold parties accountable and demand replenishment.
texts.周瑜规定遇到官船到达时，周瑜方守望人员即刻吹号集合接应并派两名信使首报。: Zhou Yu stipulated that upon arrival of official ships, Zhou Yu's lookouts should sound the horn immediately to muster and receive them and send two messengers as first reports.
texts.周瑜设立临时仓库与登记台用于暂存物资并办理登记。: Zhou Yu established temporary warehouses and a registration desk for storing supplies and registering them.
texts.周瑜预置卸货队并安排护卫队随队护航到码头。: Zhou Yu prepositioned unloading teams and arranged escort units to accompany them to the dock.
texts.命令加固博陵渡口防务：设障栅封堵可登岸处，布置弩机与弓弩手占据高地，选精兵夜间巡: Order to strengthen defenses at the Boling ferry crossing: erect barriers to block landing points, deploy crossbow machines and crossbowmen to occupy high ground, select elite soldiers for night patrols and maintain strict...
texts.命令弩手昼夜戒备，划定遇敌开火与鸣号规则：敌军任何人靠近登岸或成小股集结即命弩手: Order crossbowmen to be on guard day and night, and define rules for firing and sounding alarms upon enemy contact: if any enemy approaches a landing or gathers in small groups, order the crossbowmen to volley and sound the alarm; dispatch...
texts.命令派出三队轻骑夜探吕布军情，摸清其兵力部署与哨卡布置；连写密信数封并拴于箭上，: Order three light cavalry units to conduct night reconnaissance on Lü Bu's forces to ascertain his troop deployments and sentry-post arrangements; write several sealed letters and tie them to arrows, prepared to shoot them toward small...
texts.命令随从星夜派快马前往颍川，接回徐庶之母并押护至许昌；嘱咐荀彧、程昱在许昌妥善安: Order attendants to dispatch fast horses day and night to Yingchuan to fetch Xu Shu's mother and escort her to Xuchang; instruct Xun Yu and Cheng Yu in Xuchang to properly arrange for Xu...
texts.命夏侯渊与夏侯惇各率机动骑兵五百人在许昌担任预备队待命。: Order Xiahou Yuan and Xiahou Dun to each lead 500 mobile cavalry in Xuchang as reserve forces on standby.
texts.在修订的防务表格中确认四门守备各约160人，每门包含40名弩手并实行昼夜轮换。: In the revised defense roster, confirm that each of the four gates is garrisoned by about 160 men, each gate including 40 crossbowmen and implementing day-night rotation.
texts.在听到低声口令“白云”或看到折布信号后，赵云派出的张嵩、段威、韩广、李靖和周超将: Upon hearing the low-voice password 'White Cloud' or seeing the folded-cloth signal, Zhang Song, Duan Wei, Han Guang, Li Jing, and Zhou Chao dispatched by Zhao Yun will assist and guide the main force into the inner side.
texts.在孙乾呈交盘点单后，糜竺在十五分钟内呈交逐项精确数值与补给建议。: After Sun Qian submitted the inventory list, Mi Zhu presented precise itemized figures and supply recommendations within fifteen minutes.
texts.在府中设议事厅，备置案几与酒食，派遣更快的信使催促荀谌、辛评、关纯及其他谋士速来: Set up a council hall in the residence with tables and food and drink, send faster messengers to urge Xun Chen, Xin Ping, Guan Chun and other strategists to hasten to Chenliu for the meeting, to jointly discuss whether to invite...
texts.在府内四处寻找王允，前往画阁呼唤王允，查看画阁内是否有人在场。: Search throughout the residence for Wang Yun, go to the painting pavilion to call for Wang Yun, and check whether anyone is present in the painting pavilion.
texts.在新野，诸葛亮向张飞、赵云和许褚分配了作战任务。: At Xinye, Zhuge Liang assigned combat tasks to Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, and Xu Chu.
texts.在樊城，刘备下令准许孙乾出使江东以试探孙权。: At Fancheng, Liu Bei ordered that Sun Qian be permitted to go as envoy to Jiangdong to probe Sun Quan.
texts.在汉水与黄河的许昌附近主要渡口各置水师与轻骑哨队封渡盘查以防敌渡河。: At the main ferry crossings near Xuchang on the Han River and the Yellow River, assign naval forces and light cavalry pickets to block crossings and inspect to prevent enemy river crossings.
texts.在许昌严密防范内应与消息外泄，制定防范措施并由荀彧与程昱监管执行。: In Xuchang, tightly guard against internal collusion and information leaks, formulate preventive measures, and have Xun Yu and Cheng Yu supervise implementation.
texts.在许昌主要渡口设置浮桥警戒并安排暗哨以防止敌方偷渡。: At Xuchang's main ferry crossings, set floating-bridge sentries and arrange concealed scouts to prevent enemy clandestine crossings.
texts.在许昌外围的重要隘口加设障槊与陷阱以阻遏敌军通过要道。: At important strategic passes on the outskirts of Xuchang, install barricades and traps to impede enemy movement along the main routes.
texts.在许昌防务初稿中，徐庶安排路三侦察点于博陵渡口西北，命于禁率100骑驻守并负责该: In the Xuchang defense draft, Xu Shu assigned the Route Three reconnaissance point northwest of the Boling ferry and ordered Yu Jin to garrison it with 100 cavalry and be responsible for reconnaissance along that line.
texts.在许昌防务初稿中，徐庶安排路二侦察点于濮阳南侧掩蔽林，命乐进率100骑驻守并负责: In the Xuchang defense draft, Xu Shu assigned the Route Two reconnaissance point in the sheltering woods south of Puyang and ordered Yue Jin to garrison it with 100 cavalry and be responsible for reconnaissance along that line.
texts.在许昌防务初稿中，徐庶建议南门、北门、东门、西门四门各守备约160人，每门含40: In the Xuchang defense draft, Xu Shu recommended roughly 160 defenders at each of the four gates—South, North, East, and West—each including 40 crossbowmen and operating in day-night rotations.
texts.在许昌防务初稿中，徐庶建议沿外壕每里设三哨，每哨配属50人以加强边防覆盖。: In the Xuchang defense draft, Xu Shu recommended three sentry posts per li along the outer moat, each staffed with 50 men to strengthen border coverage.
texts.在许昌防务初稿中，徐庶要求外壕哨夜间实行两班巡逻，并设置暗哨与陷阱以防敌暗袭。: In the Xuchang defense draft, Xu Shu required the outer-moat sentries to conduct two shifts of patrols at night and to deploy hidden posts and traps to guard against enemy night assaults.
texts.在许昌防务初稿中，徐庶要求每哨与每队配备联络官直通许昌都督部，触发救援条件为城门: In the Xuchang defense draft, Xu Shu required each sentry and each unit to have a liaison officer with direct access to the Xuchang Command; triggers for dispatching reinforcements are a city gate being threatened or a pass being lost.
texts.在许昌防务初稿中，徐庶规定缴获与补给由联络官押运至许昌都督部指定仓库，乐进负责点: In the Xuchang defense draft, Xu Shu stipulated that captured goods and supplies be escorted by liaison officers to the Xuchang Command's designated warehouse, with Yue Jin responsible for inventory, accounting, and reporting to the Command.
texts.在许昌，于禁下令立即封固外门并加固城墙。: In Xuchang, Yu Jin ordered the outer gates sealed immediately and the city walls reinforced.
texts.在许昌，于禁督守北门并与精锐预备队联应。: In Xuchang, Yu Jin supervised the defense of the North Gate and coordinated with the elite reserve force.
texts.在许昌，徐庶已将防务初稿整理为逐处表格并列出缺口物资清单，呈送给程昱和张都督审阅: In Xuchang, Xu Shu organized the defense draft into location-by-location tables and listed a shortage inventory, submitting it to Cheng Yu and Commander Zhang for review.
texts.在许昌，徐庶请程昱與张都督批示是否即刻按该缺口物资清单调拨物资并批准各哨长人选。: In Xuchang, Xu Shu asked Cheng Yu and Commander Zhang to authorize whether to immediately allocate supplies according to the shortage list and to approve the nominated sentry chiefs.
texts.在许昌，荀彧、程昱与徐庶负责情报收集与暗中侦察。: In Xuchang, Xun Yu, Cheng Yu, and Xu Shu were responsible for intelligence gathering and covert reconnaissance.
texts.在许褚或张勇核实情报后，相关部队将由许褚或张勇下令发起行动。: After Xu Chu or Zhang Yong verified the intelligence, the relevant units would be ordered to initiate action by Xu Chu or Zhang Yong.
texts.在诸葛亮草庐内检查文书存放处：开柜查看书卷、信札及文房四宝摆放是否整齐、是否有外: Inspect the document storage inside Zhuge Liang's thatched cottage: open the cabinet to check whether scrolls, letters, and the Four Treasures of the Study (brush, ink, paper, inkstone) are neatly arranged and whether there are signs of tampering by outsiders, and record any findings.
texts.在这次夜袭行动中，赵云负责截断敌军并提供掩护。: In this night raid, Zhao Yun was responsible for cutting off the enemy and providing covering support.
texts.在通往陈留与汝南的必经要道布设路障并埋伏伏兵以防敌军突进。: On the main roads leading to Chenliu and Runan, set up roadblocks and ambush troops to prevent enemy breakthroughs.
texts.在馆驿交接的家书或摹本于验认完毕后须由交接方立即归还。: Letters or copies handed over at the courier relay station must be returned immediately by the transferring party after verification is complete.
texts.城内守夜人员识别许褚一方的标志为白布臂章，并以口令“新野/是”确认。: Night watchmen inside the city identified Xu Chu's side by a white cloth armband and confirmed with the password "Xinye/yes".
texts.夏侯惇下令初报须列出各队联络官姓名与联络方式以便通信联络。: Xiahou Dun ordered that the initial report must list each unit's liaison officers' names and contact methods for communications.
texts.夏侯惇下令初报须列明可用于城内巡逻与三路侦骑之兵数，并注明各队拟分配路线与当前驻: Xiahou Dun ordered the initial report to specify the numbers of troops available for city patrols and for the three reconnaissance cavalry routes, and to indicate each unit's intended allocation routes and current station coordinates.
texts.夏侯惇下令初报须列明城内精锐预备队人数、把守要道部署与候命地点。: Xiahou Dun ordered the initial report to state the elite reserve force's size in the city, their deployments guarding key routes, and their standby assembly locations.
texts.夏侯惇下令初报须列明现有军器（弩、弓、箭等）数量与短缺项。: Xiahou Dun ordered the initial report to list current weapon counts (crossbows, bows, arrows, etc.) and any shortages.
texts.夏侯惇下令初报须逐项列明东门可出动守城步卒实数，并附垛口弩手人数与昼夜轮换班次。: Xiahou Dun ordered the initial report to itemize the actual number of infantry deployable from the East Gate and to include the number of crossbowmen at the battlements and their day-night rotation shifts.
texts.夏侯惇下令初报须逐项列明北门可出动守城步卒实数，并附垛口弩手人数与昼夜轮换班次。: Xiahou Dun ordered the initial report to itemize the actual number of infantry deployable from the North Gate and to include the number of crossbowmen at the battlements and their day-night rotation shifts.
texts.夏侯惇下令初报须逐项列明南门可出动守城步卒实数，并附垛口弩手人数与昼夜轮换班次。: Xiahou Dun ordered the initial report to itemize the actual number of infantry deployable from the South Gate and to include the number of crossbowmen at the battlements and their day-night rotation shifts.
texts.夏侯惇下令初报须逐项列明各粮仓与分储谷帛实存数、可用粮袋数与短缺项，并标明预计到: Xiahou Dun ordered the initial report to itemize each granary and subsidiary storage's actual stocks of grain and silk, the number of usable grain sacks, shortages, and to specify the estimated time of arrival for reinforcements.
texts.夏侯惇下令初报须逐项列明西门可出动守城步卒实数，并附垛口弩手人数与昼夜轮换班次。: Xiahou Dun ordered the initial report to itemize the actual number of infantry deployable from the West Gate and to include the number of crossbowmen at the battlements and their day-night rotation shifts.
texts.夏侯惇下令加派弩手昼夜轮换守卫并加固许昌城墙外壕。: Xiahou Dun ordered additional crossbowmen posted in day-night rotations and the reinforcement of the outer moat of Xuchang's city walls.
texts.夏侯惇下令在许昌加派弩手，实行昼夜轮换守卫。: Xiahou Dun ordered additional crossbowmen deployed in Xuchang to perform day-night rotating guard duty.
texts.夏侯惇下令如遇可疑内应先行收押并在初报中报明被收押人名与收押情由。: Xiahou Dun ordered that any suspicious internal collaborators encountered be detained first and that the initial report state the detained person's name and the reason for detention.
texts.夏侯惇下令统筹许昌的防务。: Xiahou Dun ordered coordination of Xuchang's defenses.
texts.夏侯惇命三路轻骑从许昌出城侦察敌情。: Xiahou Dun ordered three detachments of light cavalry to sally out of Xuchang to scout the enemy.
texts.夏侯惇命令三队轻骑在一时辰后同时出发。: Xiahou Dun ordered the three cavalry units to depart simultaneously after one shichen.
texts.夏侯惇命令侦察队与乐进、于禁、程昱、荀彧保持情报通合并随时交换情报。: Xiahou Dun ordered the reconnaissance units to maintain information exchange with Yue Jin, Yu Jin, Cheng Yu, and Xun Yu and to exchange intelligence at all times.
texts.夏侯惇在许昌下令在敌军必经要道布置伏兵以设下埋伏。: Xiahou Dun ordered in Xuchang that ambush troops be deployed on the enemy's routes of passage to set ambushes.
texts.夏侯惇在许昌下令对遇到的所有可疑人员立即收押审查。: Xiahou Dun ordered in Xuchang that all suspicious persons encountered be immediately detained and screened.
texts.夏侯惇在许昌下令，限一时辰内将初报呈于都督部以便统筹。: Xiahou Dun ordered in Xuchang that the initial report be presented to the command headquarters within one shichen to facilitate coordination.
texts.夏侯惇在许昌任命于禁把守许昌北门。: Xiahou Dun appointed Yu Jin to guard Xuchang's north gate.
texts.夏侯惇在许昌任命张辽总摄指挥全军军务。: Xiahou Dun appointed Zhang Liao to oversee and command the army's military affairs.
texts.夏侯惇在许昌向张辽建议立即封固外门以防敌人外部突袭。: Xiahou Dun advised Zhang Liao in Xuchang to immediately seal the outer gates to guard against an external enemy assault.
texts.夏侯惇在许昌向汉献帝禀报。: Xiahou Dun reported to Emperor Xian of Han in Xuchang.
texts.夏侯惇在许昌命令各将逐一禀报可出动兵力以及守门与侦骑的配备情况。: Xiahou Dun ordered each general to report in turn the forces available for deployment and the arrangements for gate guards and reconnaissance cavalry.
texts.夏侯惇在许昌命令速将封门、增兵、侦察和设伏等防守措施彻底落实。: Xiahou Dun ordered in Xuchang that gate sealing, troop reinforcement, reconnaissance, and ambush measures be rapidly and thoroughly implemented.
texts.夏侯惇在许昌委任乐进督管粮草后勤。: Xiahou Dun appointed Yue Jin to supervise grain and logistical support.
texts.夏侯惇在许昌对众将与谋臣说明当前首务是固守许昌并遵从程昱所提的作战方策。: Xiahou Dun told the generals and advisors in Xuchang that the current priority is to hold Xuchang and to follow the battle plan proposed by Cheng Yu.
texts.夏侯惇在许昌建议向张辽分三路轻骑出城侦察并在必经要道设伏以断敌粮道。: Xiahou Dun suggested to Zhang Liao in Xuchang to dispatch three detachments of light cavalry from the city to scout and to set ambushes on the enemy's required routes to cut off their supply lines.
texts.夏侯惇已令即刻封固许昌的外门。: Xiahou Dun has already ordered the outer gates of Xuchang to be sealed immediately.
texts.夏侯惇指示每队轻骑实出一百骑，由夏侯渊、乐进、于禁分别率领。: Xiahou Dun instructed each cavalry detachment to actually field 100 riders, to be led respectively by Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, and Yu Jin.
texts.夏侯惇要求侦察队遇敌或见补给线迹象时立即速报并连夜回报。: Xiahou Dun required reconnaissance units to immediately report upon encountering the enemy or signs of supply lines and to return and report during the night.
texts.夏侯惇要求每队配一名联络官，联络官与许昌都督部保持直通。: Xiahou Dun required each detachment be assigned one liaison officer who maintains direct communication with the Xuchang command headquarters.
texts.夏侯惇规定侦察队的回报频率为每日日出与日落各一次。: Xiahou Dun stipulated that reconnaissance units report twice daily, once at sunrise and once at sunset.
texts.夏侯渊、乐进、于禁所率三队轻骑分三路行动。: The three light cavalry detachments led by Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, and Yu Jin proceeded along three routes.
texts.夏侯渊向张辽回报：他率领的三路轻骑已整顿完毕并同时出城。: Xiahou Yuan reported to Zhang Liao that the three detachments he led had been assembled and had left the city simultaneously.
texts.夏侯渊向张辽回报：目前暂未见敌主力接近。: Xiahou Yuan reported to Zhang Liao that, for the time being, no enemy main force had approached.
texts.夏侯渊在报告中称短缺物资为重弩和若干辎重马匹，并要求乐进汇总并调拨补给。: Xiahou Yuan reported shortages of heavy crossbows and several baggage horses and requested Yue Jin to compile and reallocate supplies.
texts.夏侯渊在许昌下令抽出二十骑护送所缴获的补给回都督部。: Xiahou Yuan ordered in Xuchang that twenty riders be detached to escort the captured supplies back to the command headquarters.
texts.夏侯渊在许昌向都督部、张辽与汉献帝呈报初报。: Xiahou Yuan in Xuchang presented the initial report to the command headquarters, Zhang Liao, and Emperor Xian of Han.
texts.夏侯渊在许昌向都督部呈报目前守备与侦骑部署情况。: Xiahou Yuan in Xuchang reported to the command headquarters the current garrison and reconnaissance deployment situation.
texts.夏侯渊在许昌建议另留三十至五十人为预备并作为城内应急兵力。: Xiahou Yuan in Xuchang recommended leaving another 30 to 50 men in reserve to serve as an emergency force inside the city.
texts.夏侯渊在许昌建议回报频率为平时晨暮各例报一次。: Xiahou Yuan in Xuchang recommended reporting frequency be once each morning and once each evening during normal times.
texts.夏侯渊在许昌报告这些部队可于一时辰内整顿完毕并出发。: Xiahou Yuan in Xuchang reported these troops could be reorganized and depart within one shichen (approximately two hours).
texts.夏侯渊在许昌要求遇敌时即刻速报并连夜回报情报。: Xiahou Yuan in Xuchang ordered that any enemy contact be reported immediately and that intelligence be transmitted overnight.
texts.夏侯渊已派出约12名斥候进行侦察并向都督部报告侦察行动。: Xiahou Yuan had dispatched about 12 scouts to conduct reconnaissance and report the reconnaissance action to the command headquarters.
texts.夏侯渊报告城内预备约40人由夏侯惇督领以待应变。: Xiahou Yuan reported that about 40 men inside the city were held in reserve under Xiahou Dun to respond to contingencies.
texts.夏侯渊报告称四门各可出动守卒约160人，每门含弩手约40人，垛口弩手按垛位配备。: Xiahou Yuan reported that each of the four gates could deploy about 160 guards, each gate including about 40 crossbowmen; embrasure crossbowmen were assigned according to embrasures.
texts.夏侯渊报告称未发现大规模敌兵接近许昌城。: Xiahou Yuan reported that no large-scale enemy forces had been detected approaching the city of Xuchang.
texts.夏侯渊报告称第一路侦骑100人驻守陈留郊外的隐蔽高地。: Xiahou Yuan reported that the first scouting cavalry of 100 men was stationed on a concealed high ground outside the outskirts of Chenliu.
texts.夏侯渊报告称第三路侦骑100人驻守博陵渡口西北。: Xiahou Yuan reported that the third scouting cavalry of 100 men was stationed northwest of the Boling ferry crossing.
texts.夏侯渊报告称第二路侦骑100人驻守濮阳南侧的掩蔽林。: Xiahou Yuan reported that the second scouting cavalry of 100 men was stationed in the cover woods south of Puyang.
texts.夏侯渊报告粮草可维持数日，轻弩约20架，箭矢数量充足。: Xiahou Yuan reported that provisions would last several days, there were about 20 light crossbows, and the supply of arrows was sufficient.
texts.夏侯渊报告重弩与辎重马匹短缺。: Xiahou Yuan reported shortages of heavy crossbows and pack horses for the baggage train.
texts.夏侯渊拟断敌粮道并择机奔袭敌军目标。: Xiahou Yuan planned to cut the enemy's supply route and seize the opportunity to make rapid raids on enemy targets.
texts.夏侯渊率三百轻骑分三路从许昌出城侦察。: Xiahou Yuan led 300 light cavalry divided into three routes out of Xuchang to conduct reconnaissance.
texts.夏侯渊率出的三路轻骑中，每一路约一百骑。: Xiahou Yuan reported that among the three routes he led, each route consisted of about 100 cavalry.
texts.夏侯渊率第一路轻骑自许昌即刻出发执行侦察任务。: Xiahou Yuan led the first route of light cavalry to depart Xuchang immediately to carry out the reconnaissance mission.
texts.夏侯渊率约百骑从城中出发。: Xiahou Yuan led about 100 cavalry out from the city.
texts.夏侯渊率领骑兵在许昌周边巡逻。: Xiahou Yuan led cavalry patrolling around the environs of Xuchang.
texts.夏侯渊的其余部队就近隐蔽驻点戒备，并继续进行侦察。: The remainder of Xiahou Yuan's forces concealed themselves at nearby posts on guard and continued reconnaissance.
texts.夏侯渊的其余部队若遇敌，须退守有利坚固地形并速将情报传报都督部。: If the remainder of his forces encountered the enemy, they were to withdraw to advantageous, fortified terrain and promptly relay intelligence to the command headquarters.
texts.夏侯渊被令在必经要道设伏以断敌粮道。: Xiahou Yuan was ordered to set ambushes on the key thoroughfare the enemy must use to sever their supply route.
texts.夏侯渊请求即刻整顿他麾下的轻骑。: Xiahou Yuan requested permission to immediately reorganize the light cavalry under his command.
texts.夏侯渊请示可出动兵力规模以及向汉献帝和诸将回报的频率。: Xiahou Yuan asked for instructions on the scale of forces he could deploy and on how frequently to report to Emperor Xian of Han and the other generals.
texts.夏侯渊请示都督部是否准许轻骑继续深入押回缴获物，或先将现有补给证据呈送都督部审核: Xiahou Yuan asked the command headquarters whether the light cavalry were permitted to continue deeper to escort back captured items, or whether they should first present the existing captured supply evidence to the command headquarters for inspection.
texts.夏侯渊部已截获若干敌军补给小车（夏侯渊在许昌报告）。: Xiahou Yuan reported in Xuchang that his unit had captured several enemy supply carts.
texts.夜袭由张飞率领数百名精锐作为先锋主攻。: The night raid was to be led by Zhang Fei with several hundred elite troops serving as the vanguard and main attack force.
texts.夜袭行动仅在赵云按暗号入城且许褚所派的十名掩护到位后发起。: The night attack would be launched only after Zhao Yun entered the city using the secret signal and the ten men dispatched by Xu Chu as cover were in position.
texts.夜袭起算点为从此刻起约十五分钟后。: The start time for the night attack was set for approximately fifteen minutes from now.
texts.夜间识别标志为许褚及其随行人员佩戴白布臂章。: The night identification mark was that Xu Chu and his accompanying men would wear white cloth armbands.
texts.太史慈决定首选神亭岭作为驻地。: Taishi Ci decided to choose Shenting Ridge as his first choice for the encampment.
texts.太史慈可以在三日内集结五百人。: Taishi Ci can gather 500 men within three days.
texts.太史慈同意举荐韩当为副将。: Taishi Ci agreed to recommend Han Dang as deputy general.
texts.太史慈同意举荐黄盖负责督造器械并主导火攻事宜。: Taishi Ci agreed to recommend Huang Gai to supervise the manufacture of equipment and to lead fire-attack operations.
texts.太史慈向张昭表示太史慈愿面见并投奔孙策。: Taishi Ci told Zhang Zhao that he was willing to meet and join Sun Ce.
texts.太史慈向张昭表示愿以武力辅国。: Taishi Ci told Zhang Zhao he was willing to assist the state with military force.
texts.太史慈向张昭表示愿以自身威望稳固人心。: Taishi Ci told Zhang Zhao he was willing to use his personal prestige to stabilize popular support.
texts.太史慈向张昭表示愿护卫幼主孙权。: Taishi Ci told Zhang Zhao he was willing to protect the young lord Sun Quan.
texts.太史慈向张昭表示愿督军戍守边防要地。: Taishi Ci told Zhang Zhao he was willing to supervise the troops guarding border strongholds.
texts.太史慈向张昭询问孙策现在在哪里。: Taishi Ci asked Zhang Zhao where Sun Ce was now.
texts.太史慈向张昭说明太史慈投奔孙策的目的是打探江东形势。: Taishi Ci explained to Zhang Zhao that his purpose in joining Sun Ce was to scout the situation in Jiangdong.
texts.太史慈在江东对张昭提出，应以神亭岭和会稽为首要据点。: In Jiangdong, Taishi Ci proposed to Zhang Zhao that Shenting Ridge and Kuaiji be the primary strongholds.
texts.太史慈在神亭岭初驻五百人，并可增二百人为后援。: Taishi Ci initially stationed 500 men at Shenting Ridge, and could add 200 more as reinforcement.
texts.太史慈将亲卫与佐将的人选暂时委由张昭及其同僚荐介。: Taishi Ci temporarily entrusted the selection of his personal guards and subordinate officers to recommendations by Zhang Zhao and his colleagues.
texts.太史慈将留五十名亲卫常侍幼主孙权。: Taishi Ci would leave 50 personal guards to attend the young lord Sun Quan.
texts.太史慈希望借见孙策或孙权面陈寸心，并共商守护与兵权分配之策。: Taishi Ci hoped to obtain an audience with Sun Ce or Sun Quan to present his intentions and to jointly discuss plans for protection and the allocation of military authority.
texts.太史慈愿率精锐五百人驻守神亭岭。: Taishi Ci was willing to lead 500 elite troops to garrison Shenting Ridge.
texts.太史慈整顿军队并待命，等待进一步的指示或任命。: Taishi Ci reorganized his troops and stood by, awaiting further orders or appointments.
texts.太史慈表示可以即刻领命赴任，亦愿待被引见于孙权并受正式署命后再去就任。: Taishi Ci said he could take up the post immediately, or he would wait to be introduced to Sun Quan and receive a formal commission before assuming the position.
texts.太史慈表示若兵力允许，他希望在神亭岭再增二百人为后援。: Taishi Ci said that if manpower permitted, he hoped to add another 200 men at Shenting Ridge as reinforcement.
texts.太史慈表示若军务迫切，他可在接到命令后即刻行动，不待正名。: Taishi Ci said that if military matters were urgent, he could act immediately upon receiving orders without waiting for formal appointment.
texts.太史慈表示若孙权下令，太史慈可以先呈表并听命后即行执行。: Taishi Ci said that if Sun Quan ordered, he could first submit a memorial and then carry out the orders.
texts.太史慈请张昭代为引见孙策，或替太史慈向孙策呈报太史慈关于驻守神亭岭和会稽的建议。: Taishi Ci asked Zhang Zhao to introduce him to Sun Ce, or to report to Sun Ce Taishi Ci's proposals regarding garrisoning Shenting Ridge and Kuaiji.
texts.太史慈请张昭引见孙策或荐介於孙权。: Taishi Ci asked Zhang Zhao to introduce him to Sun Ce or recommend him to Sun Quan.
texts.太史慈请求张昭先将他引见给孙权，以为其任命正名。: Taishi Ci requested Zhang Zhao to first introduce him to Sun Quan to legitimize his appointment.
texts.如果军务迫切，太史慈可以先率领部众前往赴任，不必等张昭上呈给孙权。: If military affairs were urgent, Taishi Ci could lead his men to take up the post without waiting for Zhang Zhao to submit a memorial to Sun Quan.
texts.孙乾估算按日耗200石，现有粮约可维持约10日。: Sun Qian estimated a daily consumption of 200 shi; the current grain would last about 10 days.
texts.孙乾估计樊城刀剑约1500把。: Sun Qian estimated about 1,500 swords and sabers at Fancheng.
texts.孙乾估计樊城可用粮约2000石。: Sun Qian estimated about 2,000 shi of usable grain at Fancheng.
texts.孙乾估计樊城完好铠甲约500副。: Sun Qian estimated about 500 complete suits of armor in good condition at Fancheng.
texts.孙乾估计樊城弓弩约1000副。: Sun Qian estimated about 1,000 bows and crossbows at Fancheng.
texts.孙乾估计樊城粮仓总容量约8000石。: Sun Qian estimated Fancheng's granary total capacity at about 8,000 shi.
texts.孙乾估计樊城铠甲约600副。: Sun Qian estimated Fancheng had about 600 suits of armor.
texts.孙乾在樊城向刘备口头报告。: Sun Qian orally reported to Liu Bei in Fancheng.
texts.孙乾在樊城向刘备建议优先拨付第三项为甲胄修补。: Sun Qian in Fancheng suggested to Liu Bei that the third item be prioritized for disbursement: armor repair.
texts.孙乾在樊城向刘备提出外交建议：速试探江东以争取援粮4000石。: Sun Qian in Fancheng proposed a diplomatic suggestion to Liu Bei: quickly probe Jiangdong to seek 4,000 shi of grain aid.
texts.孙乾在樊城向刘备提出外交策略目标为与江东采取“条件性协作”。: Sun Qian in Fancheng proposed to Liu Bei a diplomatic strategy goal of adopting 'conditional cooperation' with Jiangdong.
texts.孙乾在樊城向糜竺呈报樊城军需的现场估计。: Sun Qian in Fancheng presented on-site estimates of Fancheng's military supplies to Mi Zhu.
texts.孙乾在樊城当面向刘备呈报樊城粮草合計約2000石。: Sun Qian in Fancheng personally reported to Liu Bei that Fancheng's total grain and forage amounted to about 2,000 shi.
texts.孙乾在樊城请示刘备是否准其即刻出使江东试探孙权。: Sun Qian in Fancheng asked Liu Bei for permission to immediately go as an envoy to Jiangdong to probe Sun Quan.
texts.孙乾在樊城请示刘备是否准在详细盘点到手前先行分批拨付优先项，先拨粮草与兵饷、次拨: Sun Qian in Fancheng asked Liu Bei for permission to, before detailed inventory arrives, disburse prioritized items in batches: first grain, forage, and soldiers' pay; next crossbows, bows, and arrows.
texts.孙乾已命樊城仓曹即刻清点库房物资并逐项盘点。: Sun Qian has ordered the Fancheng warehouse officers to immediately count the storeroom supplies and inventory them item by item.
texts.孙乾已命樊城仓曹将逐项盘点单呈送糜竺与孙乾本人。: Sun Qian has ordered the Fancheng warehouse officers to submit the itemized inventory list to Mi Zhu and to Sun Qian himself.
texts.孙乾建议刘备次补弓弩与箭矢。: Sun Qian recommended to Liu Bei that bows, crossbows, and arrows be replenished next.
texts.孙乾建议并请示刘备：首务速补樊城的粮草与兵饷。: Sun Qian suggested and requested Liu Bei's approval: first priority is to quickly replenish Fancheng's grain, forage, and soldiers' pay.
texts.孙乾报告库中军资可发约15日的兵饷。: Sun Qian reported the stores contain military funds sufficient to issue soldiers' pay for about 15 days.
texts.孙乾报告樊城日耗粮约200石。: Sun Qian reported Fancheng's daily grain consumption is about 200 shi.
texts.孙乾报告樊城的盘点单正由仓曹装订，十五分钟内呈上给刘备。: Sun Qian reported Fancheng's inventory list is being bound by the warehouse officers and will be presented to Liu Bei within fifteen minutes.
texts.孙乾报告樊城箭约4万支。: Sun Qian reported Fancheng has about 40,000 arrows.
texts.孙乾报告樊城粮仓总容量约8000石，其中部分仓房受潮损毁。: Sun Qian reported Fancheng's granaries' total capacity is about 8,000 shi, of which some granary rooms were damaged by dampness.
texts.孙乾报告樊城长兵约3000柄。: Sun Qian reported Fancheng has about 3,000 long weapons.
texts.孙乾拟根据盘点结果就是否与孙权结盟向刘备提出外交建议。: Sun Qian intends, based on the inventory results, to propose to Liu Bei a diplomatic recommendation on whether to ally with Sun Quan.
texts.孙乾要求据实将樊城军需情况向刘备呈报。: Sun Qian requested that Fancheng's military supply situation be reported to Liu Bei truthfully.
texts.孙乾说明樊城部分仓房受潮损毁，导致实际可用粮量比总容量略少。: Sun Qian explained that some granary rooms in Fancheng were damaged by dampness, causing the actual usable grain amount to be slightly less than total capacity.
texts.孙乾负责组织护送被拨发的物资，并规定长途护送以每队一百人起算。: Sun Qian was responsible for organizing escorts for the disbursed supplies and stipulated that long-distance escorts be counted at one hundred men per team.
texts.孙权命使者张某等往鄱阳湖，传旨召周瑜速来柴桑面议，携带水军训练与防务情报，共商巩: Sun Quan ordered envoys Zhang and others to Poyang Lake, sending an edict summoning Zhou Yu to come quickly to Chaisang for face-to-face discussion, bringing naval training and defense intelligence to jointly discuss plans to strengthen Jiangdong.
texts.密札表明陈登愿为曹操军营中的内应并附上一枚小令牌作为凭证。: A secret letter indicated Chen Deng was willing to act as an inside agent in Cao Cao's camp and included a small token as proof.
texts.封存荀彧、程昱所草拟之召徐书，命人即刻择可信快马密递直赴新野，务必将书私送徐庶本: Seal the summons to Xu drafted by Xun Yu and Cheng Yu, order someone to immediately choose a trustworthy fast horseman to secretly deliver it straight to Xinye, ensuring the letter is privately handed to Xu Shu himself; instructed
texts.将许昌所置的机动骑兵分三路出城侦察、截断敌方粮道，并在敌侧翼示弱时牵制出击。: Send the mobile cavalry stationed at Xuchang out of the city in three columns to scout and cut off the enemy's grain routes, and when the enemy's flank shows weakness, to hold and strike.
texts.巡视博望坡周围，呼喊曹操，搜索马蹄印、血迹、旗帜等痕迹以确认曹操下落。: Patrol around Bowang Slope, call for Cao Cao, and search for signs such as horses' hoofprints, bloodstains, and banners to confirm Cao Cao's whereabouts.
texts.巡视府内东厢、西厢、客房、厢房与门庭，逐一查看书房与书札，询问守门与内侍来客记录: Inspect the east wing, west wing, guest rooms, side rooms, and courtyard of the headquarters, check the study and correspondence one by one, ask the gate guards and eunuchs about visitor records; dispatch a fast messenger to Luoyang
texts.建議出發時限以五百人為準，自命令下達之日起三日內可行。: Recommend the departure be based on a force of 500 men; from the date the order is issued it can be carried out within three days.
texts.建議出發時限若擴編至七百或一千人，需五至七日整備。: Recommend that if the departure force is expanded to 700 or 1,000 men, five to seven days of preparation are required.
texts.张昭为太史慈留亲卫五十人。: Zhang Zhao left fifty personal guards for Taishi Ci.
texts.张昭任命韩当和黄盖为程普的随臣佐将。: Zhang Zhao appointed Han Dang and Huang Gai as Cheng Pu's attendant officers.
texts.张昭准备行路引并确定出发日期，以便颁布署命并下达整饬布令。: Zhang Zhao will prepare travel passes and fix the departure date so he can publish commissions and issue orders to muster and discipline the troops.
texts.张昭准程普率五百随行，人数可增至一千，增兵需五至七日准备。: Zhang Zhao authorized Cheng Pu to lead five hundred followers; the number may be increased to one thousand, and increasing troops requires five to seven days of preparation.
texts.张昭向朝廷上呈表，荐太史慈为督军。: Zhang Zhao submitted a memorial to the court recommending Taishi Ci as commander of the army.
texts.张昭在表中建议太史慈署驻神亭岭。: In the memorial Zhang Zhao suggested Taishi Ci be posted at Shenting Ridge.
texts.张昭将在向孙策呈荐表时恳请孙策引见孙权以正名。: When presenting the recommendation to Sun Ce, Zhang Zhao will earnestly ask Sun Ce to introduce Taishi Ci to Sun Quan to formalize his title.
texts.张昭将在收到孙策的命令后即刻启程。: Zhang Zhao will depart immediately upon receiving Sun Ce's orders.
texts.张昭将太史慈荐为督军，署于神亭岭。: Zhang Zhao recommended Taishi Ci as commander to be stationed at Shenting Ridge.
texts.张昭已告知太史慈和程普要整饬并备齐各自的军队。: Zhang Zhao has informed Taishi Ci and Cheng Pu to ready and fully prepare their respective troops.
texts.张昭并将根据军务紧急情形，决定先行颁发路引或安排引见。: Zhang Zhao will, according to the urgency of military affairs, decide whether to issue travel passes first or arrange introductions.
texts.张昭建议为幼主孙权留下五十名亲卫常侍。: Zhang Zhao recommended leaving fifty personal attendants to serve the young lord Sun Quan.
texts.张昭建议会稽预置二百人以互援神亭岭守军。: Zhang Zhao suggested Kuaiji pre-position two hundred men to support the Shenting Ridge garrison.
texts.张昭承诺若孙策批准，将颁发行路引并确定出发日期，以便下达署命与布令整饬部队。: Zhang Zhao promised that if Sun Ce approves, he will issue travel passes and set a departure date so he can issue commissions and orders to ready the troops.
texts.张昭拟于明日将荐表呈请孙权。: Zhang Zhao plans to present the recommendation to Sun Quan tomorrow.
texts.张昭拟于明日辰时将荐表呈于孙策。: Zhang Zhao plans to present the recommendation to Sun Ce tomorrow at the chen hour.
texts.张昭拟即呈表向上级推荐孙策。: Zhang Zhao intends to immediately submit a memorial to his superiors recommending Sun Ce.
texts.张昭指出太史慈的兵力可以再增二百人以增强防守。: Zhang Zhao pointed out Taishi Ci's forces can be increased by another two hundred men to strengthen the defense.
texts.张昭要求程普三日内整饬备队。: Zhang Zhao ordered Cheng Pu to ready and prepare his troops within three days.
texts.张昭计划明日向孙策呈上推荐太史慈与程普的表文。: Zhang Zhao plans to present to Sun Ce tomorrow the memorial recommending Taishi Ci and Cheng Pu.
texts.张辽下令以精锐部队为预备队据守城中隘口与要点以应变。: Zhang Liao ordered elite troops to serve as a reserve force to hold the city's narrow passes and key points to respond to emergencies.
texts.张辽下令速清点许昌的军器和粮饷并严防内泄。: Zhang Liao ordered a rapid inventory of Xuchang's weapons and grain supplies and strict prevention of any leaks.
texts.张辽令于禁守卫许昌北门。: Zhang Liao ordered Yu Jin to guard Xuchang's north gate.
texts.张辽令各将列明所需援兵物资及预计到援时点。: Zhang Liao ordered each general to list the reinforcements and supplies needed and the estimated times they will arrive.
texts.张辽令各将清点军器與粮饷并列出短缺项目。: Zhang Liao ordered each general to take inventory of weapons and grain supplies and list any shortages.
texts.张辽令各将速报可出动之守城兵力与巡逻、侦骑配备。: Zhang Liao ordered each general to promptly report deployable garrison forces and the allocations of patrol and scouting cavalry.
texts.张辽令荀彧与程昱暗中察敌并速向张辽报送敌军动向。: Zhang Liao ordered Xun Yu and Cheng Yu to secretly observe the enemy and quickly report enemy movements to Zhang Liao.
texts.张辽命侦骑遇可疑者即行收押审查。: Zhang Liao ordered scouting cavalry to immediately detain and interrogate any suspicious persons they encounter.
texts.张辽命在许昌城内留下三十至五十人为预备队。: Zhang Liao ordered that 30 to 50 men be left inside Xuchang as a reserve force.
texts.张辽命夏侯渊率轻骑分三路出城侦察敌情。: Zhang Liao ordered Xiahou Yuan to lead light cavalry out of the city in three columns to scout enemy conditions.
texts.张辽在许昌下令分三路轻骑出城侦察。: Zhang Liao in Xuchang ordered light cavalry to sally out in three columns to scout.
texts.张辽在许昌下令加固城墙。: Zhang Liao in Xuchang ordered the city walls to be reinforced.
texts.张辽在许昌下令在必经要道设伏以断敌粮道。: Zhang Liao in Xuchang ordered ambushes to be set on key routes to cut off the enemy's supply lines.
texts.张辽在许昌下令昼夜轮换弩兵值守城墙。: Zhang Liao in Xuchang ordered crossbowmen to rotate day and night to guard the city walls.
texts.张辽在许昌下令立即封固外门。: Zhang Liao in Xuchang ordered the outer gates to be immediately sealed.
texts.张辽在许昌委任乐进督管粮草补给工作。: Zhang Liao in Xuchang appointed Yue Jin to supervise grain and forage supply work.
texts.张辽在许昌要求各将速令落实布防、巡逻和侦察等部署。: Zhang Liao in Xuchang required each general to promptly order implementation of deployments, patrols, and reconnaissance.
texts.张辽在许昌通报:许昌当前军情紧要,召集荀彧、程昱等谋臣与将领共议许昌防务与应对方: Zhang Liao in Xuchang reported: the current military situation in Xuchang is critical; he summoned advisers Xun Yu, Cheng Yu, and other strategists and generals to jointly discuss Xuchang's defenses and response plans.
texts.张辽在许昌采纳了夏侯惇的上述建议并下令立即施行。: Zhang Liao in Xuchang adopted Xiahou Dun's above suggestion and ordered it to be implemented immediately.
texts.张辽已向汉献帝禀报所闻，并承诺即刻督促诸将施行皇帝所准的五策。: Zhang Liao has reported what he heard to Emperor Xian of Han and promised to immediately urge the generals to implement the five measures approved by the emperor.
texts.张辽被任为许昌防务的总摄指挥。: Zhang Liao was appointed overall commander in charge of Xuchang's defense.
texts.张辽要求侦骑将所获情报昼夜速报回营。: Zhang Liao required reconnaissance cavalry to report intelligence back to camp quickly day and night.
texts.张飞同意按既定预案发动夜袭。: Zhang Fei agreed to launch the night raid according to the established plan.
texts.张飞向许褚回报：如遇阻拦，张飞率领的三百名精锐部队将立即撤回。: Zhang Fei reported to Xu Chu: if obstructed, the 300 elite troops led by Zhang Fei will withdraw immediately.
texts.张飞向许褚回报：张飞可率领三百名精锐士兵实施夜袭。: Zhang Fei reported to Xu Chu: Zhang Fei can lead 300 elite soldiers to carry out the night raid.
texts.张飞向许褚回报：张飞计划分两路对目标进行突击。: Zhang Fei reported to Xu Chu: Zhang Fei plans to strike the target in two columns.
texts.张飞向许褚回报：拟在约十五分钟后出发发动夜袭。: Zhang Fei reported to Xu Chu: he plans to set out in about fifteen minutes to commence the night raid.
texts.张飞向许褚回报：撤退集合地点为南河桥，张飞的部队将在该处集合。: Zhang Fei reported to Xu Chu: the retreat rally point is South River Bridge, where Zhang Fei's troops will assemble.
texts.张飞向许褚回报：整个夜袭行动预计不超过三十分钟。: Zhang Fei reported to Xu Chu: the entire night raid is expected to take no more than thirty minutes.
texts.张飞命令出动三百名精锐士兵，分两路突击。: Zhang Fei ordered 300 elite soldiers to deploy and strike in two columns.
texts.张飞回报称可率三百精锐待命。: Zhang Fei reported he can lead 300 elite soldiers and stand ready.
texts.张飞率领三百名精锐士兵分两路在夜间袭击曹军先锋。: Zhang Fei led 300 elite soldiers in two columns to attack the Cao army's vanguard at night.
texts.张飞的夜袭出发信号为掩护首领张勇低声清嗓三次。: The departure signal for Zhang Fei's night raid was the covering leader Zhang Yong quietly clearing his throat three times.
texts.张飞要求突击务求速取速归，不与敌人缠斗。: Zhang Fei demanded the assault be swift—take the objective and return quickly, not to become entangled with the enemy.
texts.弩手鸣号齐射的任务是掩护系缆的船只并保护撤退通道，防止敌人切断撤退路线。: The crossbowmen's task of sounding horns and firing volleys was to cover the moored ships and protect the retreat route, preventing the enemy from cutting off the retreat.
texts.張昭備註如蒙允准，將即行擬就詳列薦介名單與行路引正文，俟孫策裁示後呈請頒行。: Zhang Zhao noted that if permitted he will immediately prepare a detailed list of recommended names and travel documents, and after Sun Ce's decision will submit them for issuance.
texts.張昭催促速決以安民心，並稱若蒙允即率所屬整軍待發。: Zhang Zhao urged a quick decision to reassure the people and said that if permitted he will lead his forces to assemble and be ready to depart.
texts.張昭又請示若孫策欲先會見正名，請示期以便具奏。: Zhang Zhao further asked whether Sun Ce wishes to meet the formally named persons first and requested a date for the meeting so he can prepare the report.
texts.張昭在表中規定以五百人為準，三日可集結。: In the memorial, Zhang Zhao stipulated that with 500 men as the baseline, they could assemble in three days.
texts.張昭在表中規定若增至七百或一千人，需五至七日以備。: In the memorial, Zhang Zhao stated that if numbers were increased to 700 or 1,000 men, preparation would require five to seven days.
texts.張昭在表文中稱呼孫策為孫都尉孫策大人。: In the memorial, Zhang Zhao addressed Sun Ce as 'Colonel Sun, Lord Sun Ce.'
texts.張昭建議太史慈初駐精銳五百人。: Zhang Zhao recommended that Taishi Ci initially station an elite force of 500 men.
texts.張昭建議會稽預置精銳二百以資互援。: Zhang Zhao suggested that Kuaiji pre-position 200 elite troops to provide mutual support.
texts.張昭懇請孫策允准並頒行路引與出發期以便各處整饬。: Zhang Zhao earnestly requested Sun Ce's approval and the issuance of travel passes and departure dates so all places could make preparations.
texts.張昭擬列韓當為程普部督率水軍之副將，專督操練巡航與臨戰指揮。: Zhang Zhao proposed naming Han Dang as Cheng Pu's deputy over the navy, specifically to oversee training, patrols, and command in battle.
texts.張昭擬呈孫策一份薦表草案。: Zhang Zhao drafted a recommendation memorial to present to Sun Ce.
texts.張昭擬薦程普率水軍隨行五百人。: Zhang Zhao proposed recommending that Cheng Pu bring 500 naval troops to accompany the force.
texts.張昭表示願代為薦介會稽及親衛等佐將之具體人選以便並奏。: Zhang Zhao offered to recommend the specific personnel choices for Kuaiji, the personal guard, and other subordinate generals so they could be submitted together.
texts.張昭說明程普水軍可按例擴充至一千人。: Zhang Zhao explained that Cheng Pu's navy could, by precedent, be expanded to 1,000 men.
texts.張昭說明若擴編，約需五日至七日方可整備具足。: Zhang Zhao explained that if expanded, it would take about five to seven days to complete preparations.
texts.張昭請示若孫策欲先引見太史慈與程普，請示可行之會見日。: Zhang Zhao asked which date would be feasible if Sun Ce wished to first receive Taishi Ci and Cheng Pu for an audience.
texts.徐庶下令各队在一时辰后同时出发。: Xu Shu ordered all units to depart simultaneously after one hour.
texts.徐庶向程昱提出：若程昱保证暗中核实并绝不外泄，徐庶可以呈上一纸家书或摹本以供验认: Xu Shu told Cheng Yu that if Cheng Yu guaranteed to verify secretly and never leak it, Xu Shu could present a family letter or a copy for verification.
texts.徐庶向程昱表示，他可以出示一封家书或该家书的摹本，供程昱验认笔迹。: Xu Shu told Cheng Yu he could show a family letter or its copy for Cheng Yu to verify the handwriting.
texts.徐庶命乐进出城侦察，率轻骑一百。: Xu Shu ordered Yue Jin to leave the city to scout, leading 100 light cavalry.
texts.徐庶命于禁出城侦察，率轻骑一百。: Xu Shu ordered Yu Jin to leave the city to scout, leading 100 light cavalry.
texts.徐庶命令受呈报的诸位将领依照许昌初报的内容逐项落实防务措施。: Xu Shu ordered the reporting generals to implement, item by item, the defensive measures specified in the initial Xuchang report.
texts.徐庶命令夏侯渊、乐进与于禁整顿完毕后速报其驻点坐标与初步情报。: Xu Shu ordered Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, and Yu Jin to, after finishing reorganization, promptly report their station coordinates and preliminary intelligence.
texts.徐庶命各将于一时辰内逐项呈报四门可出动的守城步卒人数，以便按实情部署防守。: Xu Shu ordered each general to, within one hour, report item by item the number of garrison infantry at the four gates available for deployment so defenses could be arranged accordingly.
texts.徐庶命各队出城后就近隐蔽驻点待机，并速报驻点坐标与初报情。: Xu Shu ordered each unit, after leaving the city, to take nearby concealed positions to stand by and quickly report their position coordinates and initial intelligence.
texts.徐庶命各队遇敌即刻速报，并连夜回报敌情。: Xu Shu ordered each unit to immediately report upon encountering the enemy and to send overnight reports on enemy activity.
texts.徐庶命夏侯渊出城侦察，率轻骑一百。: Xu Shu ordered Xiahou Yuan to leave the city to scout, leading 100 light cavalry.
texts.徐庶在初报中命三路出城侦察，每路实出100骑并就近隐蔽驻点，路一驻陈留郊外隐蔽高: In the initial report, Xu Shu ordered three routes to leave the city to scout, each route to send out 100 cavalry and take nearby concealed positions; Route One to station on a concealed high ground outside Chenliu, Route Two to station at Puyang.
texts.徐庶在许昌下令：夏侯渊、乐进、于禁分三路出城侦察。: In Xuchang, Xu Shu ordered Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, and Yu Jin to split into three routes and leave the city to scout.
texts.徐庶在许昌向夏侯惇、夏侯渊、乐进、于禁、程昱与张辽呈报了许昌的初报。: In Xuchang, Xu Shu presented Xuchang's initial report to Xiahou Dun, Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, Yu Jin, Cheng Yu, and Zhang Liao.
texts.徐庶在许昌向程昱回禀。: In Xuchang, Xu Shu reported back to Cheng Yu.
texts.徐庶在许昌向程昱说明，徐庶的母亲因牵连被留在许昌。: In Xuchang, Xu Shu told Cheng Yu that Xu Shu's mother had been detained in Xuchang because she was implicated.
texts.徐庶在许昌回应程昱的私下询问。: In Xuchang, Xu Shu responded to Cheng Yu's private inquiry.
texts.徐庶在许昌将许昌防务初稿呈送程昱与张辽审阅。: Xu Shu in Xuchang submitted the initial draft of Xuchang's defenses to Cheng Yu and Zhang Liao for review.
texts.徐庶在许昌恳请程昱与张辽批示并允准将初稿整理为逐处表格以便逐项签批。: Xu Shu in Xuchang earnestly requested Cheng Yu and Zhang Liao to issue directives and approve arranging the draft into itemized tables for individual sign-off.
texts.徐庶在许昌指定乐进为可信之人。: Xu Shu in Xuchang designated Yue Jin as a trusted person.
texts.徐庶在许昌根据于禁的回报修订并定稿了许昌防务表格与缺口物资清单。: Xu Shu in Xuchang revised and finalized the defense tables for Xuchang and the list of missing supplies based on Yu Jin's report.
texts.徐庶在许昌根据汉献帝的裁示调整并向军方呈交了许昌防务初报。: Xu Shu in Xuchang adjusted and submitted the initial defense report for Xuchang to the military according to Emperor Xian of Han's ruling.
texts.徐庶在许昌的初报列明三路出城的侦察方案与机动力量配置。: Xu Shu's initial report in Xuchang listed the reconnaissance plans for three routes out of the city and the allocation of mobile forces.
texts.徐庶在许昌的初报列明四门守卫与弩手的轮换安排。: Xu Shu's initial report in Xuchang listed the rotation arrangements for the four gate guards and the crossbowmen.
texts.徐庶在许昌的初报列明水险渡口的封控措施并设置暗哨。: Xu Shu's initial report in Xuchang listed measures to seal and control hazardous river crossings and the placement of hidden sentries.
texts.徐庶在许昌的初报列明陈留与汝南方向的路障设置与护运队安排。: Xu Shu's initial report in Xuchang listed the roadblock placements and escort convoy arrangements toward Chenliu and Runan.
texts.徐庶在许昌的防务会议上向张辽、荀彧、程昱、夏侯渊、夏侯惇等人建议以守城为主。: At the defense meeting in Xuchang, Xu Shu recommended to Zhang Liao, Xun Yu, Cheng Yu, Xiahou Yuan, Xiahou Dun, and others that defense should focus on holding the city.
texts.徐庶在许昌的防务会议上向张辽、荀彧、程昱、夏侯渊、夏侯惇等人建议加固许昌城门与外: At the defense meeting in Xuchang, Xu Shu suggested to Zhang Liao, Xun Yu, Cheng Yu, Xiahou Yuan, Xiahou Dun, and others to strengthen Xuchang's city gates and outer moat and replenish...
texts.徐庶在许昌的防务会议上向张辽、荀彧、程昱、夏侯渊、夏侯惇等人建议在陈留、汝南方向: At the defense meeting in Xuchang, Xu Shu suggested to Zhang Liao, Xun Yu, Cheng Yu, Xiahou Yuan, Xiahou Dun, and others to deploy roadblocks and ambushes toward Chenliu and Runan...
texts.徐庶在许昌的防务会议上向张辽、荀彧、程昱、夏侯渊、夏侯惇等人建议封堵并严守汉水、: At the defense meeting in Xuchang, Xu Shu suggested to Zhang Liao, Xun Yu, Cheng Yu, Xiahou Yuan, Xiahou Dun, and others to seal and strictly guard the Han River, the Yellow River, and other crossings.
texts.徐庶在许昌的防务会议上向张辽、荀彧、程昱、夏侯渊、夏侯惇等人建议由荀彧与程昱主理: At the defense meeting in Xuchang, Xu Shu suggested to Zhang Liao, Xun Yu, Cheng Yu, Xiahou Yuan, Xiahou Dun, and others that Xun Yu and Cheng Yu should oversee scouting and...
texts.徐庶在许昌的防务会议上向张辽、荀彧、程昱、夏侯渊、夏侯惇等人建议设立由夏侯渊和夏: At the defense meeting in Xuchang, Xu Shu suggested to Zhang Liao, Xun Yu, Cheng Yu, Xiahou Yuan, Xiahou Dun, and others to establish a unit led by Xiahou Yuan and Xiahou Dun...
texts.徐庶在许昌的防务会议上向张辽、荀彧、程昱、夏侯渊、夏侯惇等人建议预设数条安全撤退: At the defense meeting in Xuchang, Xu Shu suggested to Zhang Liao, Xun Yu, Cheng Yu, Xiahou Yuan, Xiahou Dun, and others to preset several safe retreat routes to preserve Emperor Xian of Han...
texts.徐庶在许昌请示程昱与张辽是否即刻调拨防务中的缺口物资。: Xu Shu in Xuchang asked Cheng Yu and Zhang Liao whether to immediately allocate the missing supplies in the defenses.
texts.徐庶在许昌请示程昱与张辽是否确认为各哨长人选以便任命。: Xu Shu in Xuchang asked Cheng Yu and Zhang Liao to confirm the candidates for each sentry commander so they could be appointed.
texts.徐庶将家书或其摹本的交付改为明日午后三刻，在馆驿由乐进与徐庶所委之人交接。: Xu Shu rescheduled the delivery of the family letter or its copy to tomorrow at 3:15 PM, to be handed over at the courier station by Yue Jin and the person appointed by Xu Shu.
texts.徐庶并命夏侯渊即刻下达出发令，并向徐庶回报部队整顿完毕。: Xu Shu also ordered Xiahou Yuan to issue the departure order immediately, and Xiahou Yuan reported to Xu Shu that the troops had completed reorganization.
texts.徐庶并说明验认完毕后程昱应将该家书或摹本归还给徐庶。: Xu Shu explained that after verification Cheng Yu should return the family letter or its copy to Xu Shu.
texts.徐庶承诺采纳程昱提出的各点，并表示愿即刻细列哨位与兵力布置草案，呈程昱与张辽审阅: Xu Shu promised to adopt Cheng Yu's points and said he would immediately draft a detailed plan of sentry posts and troop deployments and submit it to Cheng Yu and Zhang Liao for review.
texts.徐庶承诺，乐进与徐庶所委之人在验认家书或摹本后会将其归还并对交付全过程保密。: Xu Shu promised that Yue Jin and the person appointed by Xu Shu would return the family letter or its copy after verification and keep the entire handover process confidential.
texts.徐庶指定乐进在都督部指定仓库对押运到的截获补给进行点收并立账记录。: Xu Shu designated Yue Jin to receive and inventory the intercepted supplies escorted to the headquarters' designated warehouse and to make ledger records.
texts.徐庶指示上述各项报告将用于立即更新许昌防务初报与哨位布置。: Xu Shu instructed that the above reports be used to immediately update Xuchang's initial defense report and sentry post dispositions.
texts.徐庶要求程昱及相关交接方对整个交接与核实过程保密，不得向外公开。: Xu Shu required Cheng Yu and the parties involved in the handover to keep the entire handover and verification process confidential and not disclose it externally.
texts.徐庶要求程昱暗中核实交接的家书或摹本的内容并速行稟奏。: Xu Shu ordered Cheng Yu to secretly verify the contents of the handed-over family letter or its copy and to report promptly.
texts.徐庶规定回报频率为日出与日落各例报一次。: Xu Shu stipulated the reporting frequency as once at sunrise and once at sunset each day.
texts.徐庶请张辽批示各哨长人选并确认物资清单。: Xu Shu asked Zhang Liao to issue directives on the candidates for each sentry commander and to confirm the supplies list.
texts.徐庶请程昱与张辽核定许昌各处兵额与轮换时限，并下令各将领立刻整顿落实上述部署。: Xu Shu asked Cheng Yu and Zhang Liao to approve the troop strengths at each location in Xuchang and the rotation time limits, and ordered the generals to immediately reorganize and implement the above deployments.
texts.徐庶请程昱将核实结果尽快稟奏给上级官员。: Xu Shu asked Cheng Yu to present the verification results to their superior officers as soon as possible.
texts.徐庶请程昱核实初稿中家书保全措施的可行性。: Xu Shu asked Cheng Yu to verify the feasibility of the family-letter preservation measures in the draft.
texts.徐母的家书必须以恳孝低调语气并含家印、折痕、私称和若干笔迹特征作为核验点。: Xu Shu's mother's family letter must be in a humble, filial tone and include the family seal, creases, private forms of address, and certain handwriting features as verification markers.
texts.护运队沿小路押运补给，预计两时辰后抵达都督部。: The escort convoy is transporting supplies along a footpath and is expected to reach the command headquarters in two hours.
texts.护运队由联络官赵广领队，队伍由路上出发的十五人和城内抽出的五人组成，共二十人。: The escort convoy is led by liaison officer Zhao Guang and consists of twenty men: fifteen who set out on the road and five drawn from inside the city.
texts.接到行动信号后，伏兵与配合的门吏探子将擒杀刘备。: Upon receiving the action signal, the ambushers and cooperating gatekeepers and scouts will capture and kill Liu Bei.
texts.接到行动信号后，伏兵将截断援军的到来。: Upon the action signal, the ambushers will cut off the arrival of reinforcements.
texts.接到行动信号后，门吏与探子将封闭馆舍与外城门。: Upon the action signal, the gatekeepers and scouts will seal the guest halls and the outer city gates.
texts.掩护小队的首领在夜间以低声私语“白云”对许褚一行作二次确认。: At night the leader of the covering squad will quietly whisper 'white cloud' to Xu Chu's party for a second confirmation.
texts.掩护队长为张勇，副队长为陈武。: The cover squad leader is Zhang Yong and the deputy leader is Chen Wu.
texts.掩护首领张勇的二次确认暗号为低声说白云并折布低举。: Cover leader Zhang Yong's secondary confirmation code is to softly say 'white cloud' and lower a folded cloth.
texts.撤退信号为三短哨并口令回。: The retreat signal is three short whistle blasts together with the command 'Return'.
texts.撤退信号为许褚一方与赵云同时吹三短哨并口令“回”。: The retreat signal is Xu Chu's side and Zhao Yun simultaneously blowing three short whistles and the command 'Return'.
texts.撤退集合地点定为南河桥。: The retreat rally point is set at South River Bridge.
texts.擬列水軍副將為韓當。: It is proposed to appoint Han Dang as deputy commander of the navy.
texts.擬列督造與火攻護運之將為黃蓋。: It is proposed to appoint Huang Gai as overseer of ship construction and commander for fire-attack escort.
