texts.擬薦督率水軍者為程普（已定）。: It is proposed to recommend Cheng Pu as naval commander (confirmed).
texts.擬薦督軍署神亭嶺者為太史慈（已定）。: It is proposed to recommend Taishi Ci to oversee the military office at Shenting Ridge (confirmed).
texts.斥候初报称未遇敌主力并发现并截获若干补给小车，未见大规模敌兵接近许昌。: The scouts' initial report said they did not encounter the enemy main force and captured several supply carts; no large-scale enemy troops were seen approaching Xuchang.
texts.曹仁命令斥候在侦得张飞或其他敌情时，立即回报曹仁所在的指挥部。: Cao Ren ordered the scouts to immediately report to Cao Ren's command headquarters if they detect Zhang Fei or any other enemy situation.
texts.曹仁在博陵渡口下令催促三路斥候加速回报张飞的旗号与兵力规模。: At the Boling ferry Cao Ren ordered the three scout detachments urged to hasten reports on Zhang Fei's banners and troop numbers.
texts.曹仁在博陵渡口下令加固船只系缆以稳固停泊的船只。: At the Boling ferry Cao Ren ordered the ship moorings reinforced to secure the anchored vessels.
texts.曹仁在博陵渡口下令加固防务。: At the Boling ferry Cao Ren ordered the defenses strengthened.
texts.曹仁在博陵渡口下令布置弩机射击阵地。: At the Boling ferry Cao Ren ordered the deployment of crossbow emplacements.
texts.曹仁在博陵渡口下令派出三路斥候侦查张飞的确切方位，上游、中段、下游各一路。: At the Boling ferry Cao Ren ordered three scout parties—one upstream, one midstream, one downstream—to reconnoiter Zhang Fei's exact location.
texts.曹仁在博陵渡口下令设障栅封堵所有可登岸处。: At the Boling ferry Cao Ren ordered obstacles and barriers set up to block all landing points.
texts.曹仁在博陵渡口下令重点保护系缆船只并确保撤退通道畅通。: At the Boling ferry Cao Ren ordered priority protection for moored vessels and to ensure retreat routes remain clear.
texts.曹仁在博陵渡口为弩手划定了遇敌开火与鸣号的规则。: At the Boling ferry Cao Ren established rules for crossbowmen on when to open fire and when to sound signals upon encountering the enemy.
texts.曹仁在博陵渡口命三路哨兵（上游、中段、下游）加强观测并保持信号联络。: At the Boling ferry Cao Ren ordered three sentry positions (upstream, midstream, downstream) to strengthen observation and maintain signal communication.
texts.曹仁在博陵渡口命令弩手昼夜戒备。: At the Boling ferry Cao Ren ordered the crossbowmen to stand guard day and night.
texts.曹仁在博陵渡口命令轻装小队分段巡逻以便随时拦截张飞。: Cao Ren at the Boling ferry ordered light detachments to patrol in sections so they could intercept Zhang Fei at any time.
texts.曹仁在博陵渡口命弩手逐台检点弩机，确认弩机完好并确认箭矢数量充足。: Cao Ren at the Boling ferry ordered the crossbowmen to inspect each crossbow, confirm the crossbows were in good condition, and confirm that bolts/arrows were sufficient.
texts.曹仁在博陵渡口命弩长准备鸣号、组织齐射并同步开火以掩护友军行动。: Cao Ren at the Boling ferry ordered the chief crossbowman to prepare signals, organize a volley, and fire in unison to cover friendly forces' movements.
texts.曹仁在博陵渡口派出轻装小队沿河岸隐蔽跟踪张飞。: Cao Ren at the Boling ferry dispatched light detachments to covertly shadow Zhang Fei along the riverbank.
texts.曹仁在博陵渡口选拔精兵执行夜间巡哨。: Cao Ren at the Boling ferry selected elite soldiers to perform night sentry duty.
texts.曹仁在博陵渡口预备了两只轻舟以便快速反击或撤离。: Cao Ren at the Boling ferry prepared two light boats for quick counterattack or evacuation.
texts.曹仁指示斥候若发现敌方小股靠岸或集结，必须立刻用预定信号报告敌情。: Cao Ren instructed scouts that if they discovered enemy small units landing or assembling, they must immediately report the situation with the predetermined signal.
texts.曹仁派快马分别向小沛、下邳和徐州方向传话，请求就近部队牵制或阻截敌军，并通报当前: Cao Ren sent fast riders to Xiaopei, Xiapi, and Xuzhou respectively to request nearby forces to restrain or intercept the enemy, and to inform them of the current alert status and the locations of retreat routes.
texts.曹洪命令两队轻骑发现任何可疑情况要即刻回报并护送发现者到曹洪的营地。: Cao Hong ordered the two light cavalry units that upon discovering any suspicious situation they must immediately report and escort the discoverer to Cao Hong's camp.
texts.曹洪在博望坡下令分派两队轻骑进行侦查。: Cao Hong at the foot of Bowang Slope ordered two light cavalry units to be dispatched for reconnaissance.
texts.曹洪指示两队轻骑详查渡口、马蹄印、血迹、旗帜及可疑落单士卒的痕迹。: Cao Hong instructed the two light cavalry units to thoroughly examine the ferry, horses' hoofprints, bloodstains, banners, and traces of suspicious isolated soldiers.
texts.曹洪派出第一队轻骑沿博望坡上游直奔罗川口执行侦查任务。: Cao Hong dispatched the first light cavalry unit upstream of Bowang Slope, heading straight to Luochuankou to carry out reconnaissance.
texts.曹洪派出第二队轻骑沿博望坡下游直赴博陵渡口执行侦查任务。: Cao Hong dispatched the second light cavalry unit downstream of Bowang Slope, heading straight to the Boling ferry to carry out reconnaissance.
texts.會稽預置兵二百之佐將預留二至三員名額，張昭或孫策可定人選。: For Kuaiji's pre-deployed 200 troops, two to three staff officer slots are to be reserved; Zhang Zhao or Sun Ce may appoint the personnel.
texts.机动骚扰队的轮换计划为每五分钟一班。: The mobile harassment team's rotation schedule is one shift every five minutes.
texts.机动骚扰队的队长是周仓，副将是关平。: The mobile harassment team's captain is Zhou Cang, with Guan Ping as deputy commander.
texts.机动骚扰队首批约120名士兵出城。: Approximately 120 soldiers of the mobile harassment team departed the city in the first wave.
texts.樊城的仓曹在糜竺监督下与孙乾当面签字，并列出护库人员名单以供核查。: The granary official of Fancheng signed in person with Sun Qian under Mi Zhu's supervision and listed the names of the warehouse guards for verification.
texts.汉献帝下令主力据守许昌城内要点布防，并清点军器与粮饷。: Emperor Xian of Han ordered the main force to hold and defend key points within Xuchang and to inventory weapons and provisions.
texts.汉献帝下令加固城墙以增强城防。: Emperor Xian of Han ordered the city walls to be reinforced to strengthen the city's defenses.
texts.汉献帝下令即刻清点军器与粮饷并严防内泄。: Emperor Xian of Han ordered an immediate inventory of weapons and provisions and strict prevention of internal leaks.
texts.汉献帝下令在必经要道设伏以配合轻骑的侦察行动。: Emperor Xian of Han ordered ambushes to be set on essential routes to coordinate with light cavalry reconnaissance.
texts.汉献帝下令抽调轻骑分三路侦察并切断敌军的粮道。: Emperor Xian of Han ordered light cavalry to be dispatched in three directions for reconnaissance and to cut off the enemy's supply lines.
texts.汉献帝下令昼夜在城墙布置弩兵并进行轮换值守。: Emperor Xian of Han ordered crossbowmen to be deployed on the city walls day and night with rotational duty.
texts.汉献帝下令清点军器和粮饷以掌握军需物资。: Emperor Xian of Han ordered an inventory of weapons and provisions to account for military supplies.
texts.汉献帝下令轻骑在敌军补给线上设伏以截断敌援。: Emperor Xian of Han ordered light cavalry to ambush the enemy's supply lines to cut off their reinforcements.
texts.汉献帝下旨即刻封固许昌的外门并加固城墙。: Emperor Xian of Han decreed that Xuchang's outer gates be immediately sealed and the city walls reinforced.
texts.汉献帝任命乐进督办粮草供应。: Emperor Xian of Han appointed Yue Jin to supervise grain and forage supplies.
texts.汉献帝任命于禁守护许昌的北门。: Emperor Xian of Han appointed Yu Jin to guard the north gate of Xuchang.
texts.汉献帝任命夏侯惇督理城内外的卫戍。: Emperor Xian of Han appointed Xiahou Dun to oversee the city's garrisons inside and outside the city.
texts.汉献帝任命夏侯渊率领骑兵巡逻。: Emperor Xian of Han appointed Xiahou Yuan to lead the cavalry on patrol.
texts.汉献帝任命张辽总摄并指挥整体军务。: Emperor Xian of Han appointed Zhang Liao to oversee and command overall military affairs.
texts.汉献帝准许程昱暗中核实徐庶与其母在许昌周边的具体情形。: Emperor Xian of Han authorized Cheng Yu to secretly verify the specific situation of Xu Shu and his mother around Xuchang.
texts.汉献帝准许程昱暗中核实徐庶母亲的境遇。: Emperor Xian of Han authorized Cheng Yu to secretly verify the circumstances of Xu Shu's mother.
texts.汉献帝刘协在许昌采纳了程昱和荀彧所议的紧急军事布置。: Emperor Xian of Han (Liu Xie) in Xuchang adopted the emergency military dispositions proposed by Cheng Yu and Xun Yu.
texts.汉献帝命令夏侯渊若遇敌或发现敌方补给线迹象须即刻速报。: Emperor Xian of Han ordered Xiahou Yuan that if he encountered the enemy or discovered signs of enemy supply lines he must report immediately.
texts.汉献帝命令抽调轻骑分三路从许昌出城侦察、断敌粮道并在必经要道设伏，昼夜追踪来敌并: Emperor Xian of Han ordered light cavalry to be drawn off into three routes from Xuchang to scout, cut the enemy's grain routes, ambush on key roads, track approaching enemies day and night, and report to Xuchang promptly.
texts.汉献帝命令荀彧与程昱密察敌情并速报回朝廷。: Emperor Xian of Han ordered Xun Yu and Cheng Yu to secretly observe the enemy situation and report back to the court quickly.
texts.汉献帝命夏侯渊、乐进、于禁不得擅自深追敌主力。: Emperor Xian of Han ordered Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, and Yu Jin not to pursue the enemy main force on their own.
texts.汉献帝命夏侯渊、乐进、于禁在一时辰内向都督部呈送各门守备、巡逻与侦骑的逐项明细。: Emperor Xian of Han ordered Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, and Yu Jin to submit within one shichen a detailed itemized list to the Command Headquarters of each gate's defenses, patrols, and reconnaissance riders.
texts.汉献帝命夏侯渊、乐进、于禁在一时辰内向都督部呈送各门联络官姓名与驻点坐标。: Emperor Xian of Han ordered Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, and Yu Jin to submit within one shichen to the Command Headquarters the names and coordinates of each gate liaison officer.
texts.汉献帝命夏侯渊、乐进、于禁在一时辰内向都督部呈送当前粮饷与军器的余缺报告。: Emperor Xian of Han ordered Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, and Yu Jin to submit within one shichen to the Command Headquarters a report on current provisions and weaponry surpluses and shortages.
texts.汉献帝命夏侯渊、乐进、于禁将侦查情报于日出与日落例行报送都督部。: Emperor Xian of Han ordered Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, and Yu Jin to routinely report reconnaissance intelligence to the Command Headquarters at sunrise and sunset.
texts.汉献帝命夏侯渊、乐进、于禁遇敌时即刻速报都督部。: Emperor Xian of Han ordered Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, and Yu Jin to report to the Command Headquarters immediately when they encounter the enemy.
texts.汉献帝命夏侯渊在许昌城内留三十至五十名士兵为预备，并守卫重要渡口与要道。: Emperor Xian of Han ordered Xiahou Yuan to keep thirty to fifty soldiers inside Xuchang as reserves and to guard important ferry crossings and main roads.
texts.汉献帝命许昌主力据城中隘口与内城要点布防，并设精锐预备队以应变。: Emperor Xian of Han ordered the Xuchang main force to defend the city chokepoints and inner-city strongpoints and to set aside an elite reserve force for contingencies.
texts.汉献帝在许昌下令：命荀彧在一时辰内将各将回报汇总为许昌防务初稿。: Emperor Xian of Han in Xuchang ordered Xun Yu to, within one shichen, compile each general's reports into a draft Xuchang defense plan.
texts.汉献帝在许昌下令：遇敌重兵时夏侯渊、乐进与于禁优先退守并速传讯。: Emperor Xian of Han in Xuchang ordered that when facing a large enemy force Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, and Yu Jin should withdraw to holding positions first and dispatch messages quickly.
texts.汉献帝在许昌下令：防务初稿须列出三路巡逻与侦骑各队可出动人数与驻点坐标。: Emperor Xian of Han in Xuchang ordered that the draft defense plan must list for three patrol routes and reconnaissance cavalry teams the number of deployable personnel and their station coordinates.
texts.汉献帝在许昌下令：防务初稿须列出可疑内应名单与初步处置建议。: Emperor Xian of Han in Xuchang ordered that the draft defense plan must list suspected internal collaborators by name and initial handling recommendations.
texts.汉献帝在许昌下令：防务初稿须列出现有军器数量与短缺项。: Emperor Xian of Han in Xuchang ordered that the draft defense plan must list the current quantities of weaponry and items in short supply.
texts.汉献帝在许昌下令：防务初稿须列明各粮仓与分储谷帛实存数、可用粮袋数与短缺项，并标: Emperor Xian of Han in Xuchang ordered that the draft defense plan must state for each granary and dispersed storage the actual stocks of grain and silk, the number of usable grain sacks, shortages, and indicate the estimated time of relief arrival.
texts.汉献帝在许昌下令：防务初稿须据此提出优先补给与调配次第建议。: Emperor Xian of Han in Xuchang ordered that the draft defense plan must on that basis propose recommendations for priority resupply and allocation order.
texts.汉献帝在许昌下令：防务初稿须标明各队联络官姓名与联络方式。: Emperor Xian of Han in Xuchang ordered that the draft defense plan must specify each unit's liaison officer by name and contact method.
texts.汉献帝在许昌下令：防务初稿须逐项列明南、北、东、西四门守备，含垛口弩手人数与昼夜: Emperor Xian of Han in Xuchang ordered that the draft defense plan must itemize the defenses of the south, north, east, and west gates, including the number of crossbowmen at embrasures and day-and-night rotation shifts.
texts.汉献帝在许昌下旨：准许夏侯渊、乐进、于禁在各自驻点继续深入侦察并押回缴获的补给，: Emperor Xian of Han issued an edict in Xuchang: permit Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, and Yu to continue deep reconnaissance at their respective posts and escort captured supplies back, but prohibit Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, and Yu
texts.汉献帝在许昌任命夏侯惇督内外卫、夏侯渊率骑巡逻、乐进督粮草、于禁守北门、张辽总摄: Emperor Xian of Han in Xuchang appointed Xiahou Dun to supervise the inner and outer guards, Xiahou Yuan to lead cavalry patrols, Yue Jin to oversee grain and forage, Yu Jin to guard the north gate, and Zhang Liao to oversee and command.
texts.汉献帝在许昌准许夏侯渊、乐进、于禁继续驻点深入侦探并押回所缴补给。: Emperor Xian of Han in Xuchang authorized Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, and Yu Jin to continue stationed deep reconnaissance and to escort back captured supplies.
texts.汉献帝在许昌命令所抽轻骑昼夜追踪来敌行迹并迅速报告行踪。: Emperor Xian of Han in Xuchang ordered the detached light cavalry to track the movements of approaching enemies day and night and report their movements promptly.
texts.汉献帝在许昌责成乐进优先完成逐仓逐队粮饷与军器盘点，并点收所缴补给立账。: Emperor Xian of Han in Xuchang charged Yue Jin to prioritize completion of an inventory of provisions and weaponry for each granary and unit, and to tally and account for seized supplies.
texts.汉献帝在许昌责成夏侯惇督城内精锐与夜间巡逻并收押可疑内应。: Emperor Xian of Han at Xuchang ordered Xiahou Dun to supervise the city's elite, conduct night patrols, and detain suspicious inside collaborators.
texts.汉献帝在许昌责成夏侯渊、乐进、于禁继续就近侦探并押运缴获补给至都督部指定仓库，禁: Emperor Xian of Han at Xuchang ordered Xiahou Yuan, Yue Jin, and Yu Jin to continue nearby reconnaissance and escort seized supplies to the Command Headquarters' designated warehouse, prohibiting unauthorized pursuit of the enemy main force.
texts.汉献帝在许昌责成张辽督促四门按初报人数严守。: Emperor Xian of Han at Xuchang ordered Zhang Liao to urge the four gates to hold strictly according to the initially reported numbers.
texts.汉献帝指示若拟召回徐庶，程昱须同时上呈一个保全徐庶母亲的具体方案與安全接回办法给: Emperor Xian of Han instructed that if Xu Shu is to be recalled, Cheng Yu must simultaneously present a concrete plan to protect Xu Shu's mother and a safe retrieval method to the Xuchang court.
texts.汉献帝规定回报频率为每日日出与日落各一次，且命令遇敌时必须立即速报並连夜回奏都督: Emperor Xian of Han required reports twice daily at sunrise and sunset, and ordered that any encounter with the enemy must be reported immediately and an overnight report submitted to the Command Headquarters.
texts.汉献帝规定若可召回徐庶，则召回时须同时提出保全接回的方案。: Emperor Xian of Han stipulated that if Xu Shu can be recalled, a protection-and-retrieval plan must be submitted at the time of recall.
texts.汉献帝还命程昱一并呈报近期敌情情报与可召回贤士的名单给许昌朝廷。: Emperor Xian of Han also ordered Cheng Yu to submit recent enemy intelligence and a list of worthy men who can be recalled to the Xuchang court.
texts.汉献帝采纳了程昱所陈的五策并下旨执行。: Emperor Xian of Han adopted the five strategies presented by Cheng Yu and issued an edict to implement them.
texts.汉献帝采纳了荀彧、程昱等人为许昌防务提出的五项建议。: Emperor Xian of Han adopted five recommendations for Xuchang's defense proposed by Xun Yu, Cheng Yu, and others.
texts.沿许昌区域的主要驿路设立联络哨以确保情报速报并维持通信畅通。: Establish liaison sentries along the main courier routes around Xuchang to ensure rapid intelligence reporting and maintain communications.
texts.沿许昌外壕每一里设置三处哨点，每处哨点配备五十人值守并负责夜间巡逻。: Along Xuchang's outer moat, set three sentry posts per li, each post staffed with fifty men on duty and responsible for night patrols.
texts.沿陈留与汝南方向设护运队护送粮草，并以小股骑兵押送运输队保护补给线。: Establish convoy teams along the Chenliu and Runan directions to escort grain and forage, and assign small cavalry detachments to escort the transport teams to protect the supply lines.
texts.派两队精捷信使连夜急赴小沛接触曹操与其先锋，确认曹操是否已入徐州、其军势与意图；: Dispatch two squads of swift messengers overnight to Xiaopei to contact Cao Cao and his vanguard, confirm whether Cao Cao has entered Xuzhou, and ascertain his forces and intentions; if Cao Cao is at Xiaopei, present a letter.
texts.派出一支轻装小队沿河岸隐蔽跟踪张飞行踪，保持十步一哨的观察距离并随时回报；命令弩: Send a light-equipped squad to shadow Zhang Fei covertly along the riverbank, maintaining observation posts every ten paces and reporting at all times; order crossbowmen to act against anyone attempting to come ashore or approach.
texts.派数骑精探直奔曹操军营四周侦查：若觅得曹操、张辽或其先锋，递呈书札表明陈登愿为内: Dispatch several mounted scouts to recon around Cao Cao's camp: if they find Cao Cao, Zhang Liao, or his vanguard, present a letter stating Chen Deng's willingness to act as an insider and request a prompt meeting, and report the situation.
texts.派遣两名暗探往张绣可能去处打探行踪，令馆舍门吏与外城探子暗中查访，务须得报速来禀: Send two undercover agents to likely locations of Zhang Xiu to probe his movements, order lodging gatekeepers and outer-city scouts to covertly investigate and report swiftly; if there is any sign of disturbance,
texts.派遣信使赴邀荀谌、辛评、关纯等谋士到陈留相商：是否请袁绍来共理冀州事务。: Send a messenger to invite advisers Xun Chen, Xin Ping, Guan Chun, and others to Chenliu to consult on whether to invite Yuan Shao to jointly manage Ji Province affairs.
texts.流程规定由乐进在子时取徐母家书以取信并现场做初验，按印章、折痕、私称、笔迹做速验: Procedure specifies that Yue Jin at the zi hour (midnight) will take Xu Shu's mother's family letter to gain trust and perform an on-site initial verification, quickly checking seal, fold marks, private forms of address, and handwriting.
texts.演说稿开场拟由程普自我简介并表明对孙权的忠诚与效命之心以取得信任与权威。: The speech opening is planned for Cheng Pu to introduce himself and state his loyalty and willingness to serve Sun Quan in order to gain trust and authority.
texts.盘点单到手后，孙乾当面将盘点单呈交糜竺。: After receiving the inventory list, Sun Qian will personally present the inventory list to Mi Zhu.
texts.督察江夏水师：清点战船与船员，检修橹桨与连桩，安排水军近岸操练，试验火攻用油脂与: Inspect the Jiangxia navy: count warships and crews, repair oars and tie-posts, arrange near-shore drills for the navy, test fire attacks using oil and incendiary materials, and record deficiencies and
texts.程昱与荀彧暗中察敌并速将情报报送夏侯惇。: Cheng Yu and Xun Yu secretly observe the enemy and promptly send the intelligence to Xiahou Dun.
texts.程昱仅对必要首长如张辽和荀彧密稟徐母家书的认证结果。: Cheng Yu reports the authentication result of Xu Shu's mother's letter only to necessary commanders such as Zhang Liao and Xun Yu.
texts.程昱叮嘱乐进路上戒言，途中不得向他人多说此事并注意保密。: Cheng Yu admonishes Yue Jin to be cautious in speech en route, not to tell others much about the matter, and to keep it confidential.
texts.程昱同时下令若押运途中遇到敌方势力强大，则先保全兵力退守坚固地形并迅速传信报告情: Cheng Yu also ordered that if the escort encounters an overwhelmingly strong enemy force en route, they should first preserve their troops by withdrawing to strong terrain and quickly send a message reporting the situation.
texts.程昱命令由联络官向都督部和押运部队报告预计到达的时点。: Cheng Yu ordered the liaison officer to report the estimated time of arrival to the Command Headquarters and to the escorting troops.
texts.程昱命夏侯渊令夏侯渊余下的部队就近隐蔽驻点戒备以保护押运行动。: Cheng Yu ordered Xiahou Yuan to have Xiahou Yuan's remaining troops conceal themselves nearby and garrison on alert to protect the escort operation.
texts.程昱嘱咐由夏侯渊抽出的二十骑护运队择牢靠的小道返回许昌。: Cheng Yu instructed that the twenty riders drawn from Xiahou Yuan as the escort team should choose a secure back road to return to Xuchang.
texts.程昱在许昌向张辽陈述：当前首要任务是固守许昌，保全天子和军需。: In Xuchang, Cheng Yu told Zhang Liao that the current top priority is to hold Xuchang and protect the Son of Heaven and the military supplies.
texts.程昱在许昌向徐庶借了一封家书以验证徐庶母亲的笔迹。: In Xuchang, Cheng Yu borrowed a family letter from Xu Shu to verify Xu Shu's mother's handwriting.
texts.程昱在许昌命令夏侯渊将夏侯渊所缴获的补给押回都督部。: In Xuchang, Cheng Yu ordered Xiahou Yuan to escort the supplies Xiahou Yuan had captured back to the command headquarters.
texts.程昱在许昌拟定并下令实施以徐母家书召回徐庶的计策。: In Xuchang, Cheng Yu devised and ordered the implementation of a plan to recall Xu Shu using a family letter from Xu Shu's mother.
texts.程昱在许昌的防务会议上向张辽、徐庶、荀彧、夏侯惇、夏侯渊等人提出五策。: At a defense meeting in Xuchang, Cheng Yu presented five strategies to Zhang Liao, Xu Shu, Xun Yu, Xiahou Dun, Xiahou Yuan, and others.
texts.程昱委托乐进，今夜子时在许昌城东一处隐蔽地点代为取徐母的家书或其摹本。: Cheng Yu entrusted Yue Jin to, at midnight tonight, retrieve Xu Shu's mother's letter or a copy from a concealed spot east of Xuchang.
texts.程昱对徐母家书的认证结果按“确实、疑似、伪”三档分别处置。: Handle the authentication results of Xu Shu's mother's letter according to three categories: authentic, suspected, forged.
texts.程昱建议由荀彧与程昱暗中察看敌情并速报敌军动向。: Cheng Yu suggested that Xun Yu and Cheng Yu secretly observe the enemy situation and quickly report enemy troop movements.
texts.程昱建议速清点军器粮饷，严防消息内泄，稳固军心。: Cheng Yu recommended quickly inventorying weapons and grain, strictly preventing information leaks, and stabilizing troop morale.
texts.程昱指示押运路线择取牢靠的小道行进以减少暴露风险。: Cheng Yu instructed that the transport route use secure small roads to reduce exposure risk.
texts.程昱指示这支二十骑护运队遇到敌人时先保全兵力，并迅速向都督部传信报告。: Cheng Yu instructed that this escort of twenty horsemen, if they encountered the enemy, should first preserve their force and quickly send word to the command headquarters.
texts.程昱的另一个目的是为日后用家书召回徐庶做准备。: Another purpose of Cheng Yu was to prepare for using a family letter later to recall Xu Shu.
texts.程昱的目的是暗中核实徐庶与徐庶母亲的关系。: The purpose was to secretly verify the relationship between Xu Shu and his mother.
texts.程昱要求乐进在验认笔迹后即刻将该家书或摹本归还并迅速到程昱处禀报情况。: Cheng Yu required Yue Jin, after verifying the handwriting, to immediately return the family letter or copy and quickly report the situation to Cheng Yu.
texts.程普为战船备置舵、桨、帆、橹等关键备件。: Cheng Pu prepared key spare parts for warships, including rudders, oars, sails, and paddles.
texts.程普主张与地方豪族联络以稳固后方，提出招抚授任并签订合约以换取支持与安定。: Cheng Pu advocated contacting local powerful families to secure the rear, proposing to recruit and appoint them and sign agreements in exchange for support and stability.
texts.程普主张加强水军训练并部署火攻战术，以提升对敌舰队的实战打击与心理威慑能力。: Cheng Pu advocated strengthening naval training and deploying fire-attack tactics to improve combat effectiveness against enemy fleets and to provide psychological deterrence.
texts.程普可以在三日内集结五百人。: Cheng Pu can assemble 500 men within three days.
texts.程普向孙权提出整顿水军的计策，内容包括修船备件、编制操练与设立信号制度。: Cheng Pu proposed to Sun Quan a plan to reorganize the navy, including repairing ships and spare parts, organizing drills, and establishing a signaling system.
texts.程普向孙权荐介韩当与黄盖为随臣佐将，推荐二人为随军助战的将领人选。: Cheng Pu recommended Han Dang and Huang Gai to Sun Quan as attendant officers and supporting generals to accompany the army in battle.
texts.程普向张昭表态，程普亦愿先由张昭引见孙权以正名。: Cheng Pu told Zhang Zhao that he was willing to be presented to Sun Quan by Zhang Zhao to legitimize his position.
texts.程普向张昭表态，程普可即刻赴任以应急。: Cheng Pu told Zhang Zhao he could assume his post immediately to respond to the emergency.
texts.程普向张昭表态，程普建议修治战船。: Cheng Pu suggested repairing and refitting warships.
texts.程普向张昭表态，程普建议固守诸浦口。: Cheng Pu suggested defending the mouths of the various inlets.
texts.程普向张昭表态，程普建议屯粮并掌管粮运。: Cheng Pu suggested stockpiling grain and taking charge of grain transport.
texts.程普向张昭表态，程普建议整顿水军。: Cheng Pu suggested reorganizing the navy.
texts.程普向张昭表态，程普建议联络当地豪族以稳固后方。: Cheng Pu suggested contacting local powerful families to secure the rear.
texts.程普向张昭表态，程普建议设烽警与巡哨。: Cheng Pu suggested establishing beacon signals and patrols.
texts.程普向张昭表态，程普愿主掌水军把守会稽与沿海要冲。: Cheng Pu offered to take command of the navy to guard Kuaiji and key coastal chokepoints.
texts.程普向张昭表态，程普愿意领兵守要。: Cheng Pu was willing to lead troops to defend strategic points.
texts.程普向张昭表态，程普推荐可托付韩当与黄盖协助。: Cheng Pu recommended Han Dang and Huang Gai as trusted assistants.
texts.程普向张昭表态，程普表示将当面具陈详尽策略。: Cheng Pu stated he would present the detailed strategy in person.
texts.程普在执行时序中表明若奏准，闻令三日内将率五百精锐出发，迅速落实行动部署。: Cheng Pu stated, during execution planning, that if approved he would, upon receiving the order, lead 500 elite troops to depart within three days and promptly implement the operational deployment.
texts.程普在江东下令整饬五百名精锐甲士。: Cheng Pu in Jiangdong ordered the mustering of 500 elite armored soldiers.
texts.程普在江东召集船匠检修战船。: Cheng Pu in Jiangdong summoned shipwrights to repair the warships.
texts.程普在江东向张昭荐介韩当和黄盖，推荐二人承担军职。: Cheng Pu in Jiangdong recommended Han Dang and Huang Gai to Zhang Zhao, proposing the two assume military posts.
texts.程普在江东拟定面陈并请缨觐见孙权，准备亲自向孙权陈述对抗策略并请求出征许可。: Cheng Pu in Jiangdong drafted a memorial and volunteered to see Sun Quan in person to present his counter-strategy and request permission to lead an expedition.
texts.程普在江东整饬军装。: Cheng Pu in Jiangdong ordered the preparation of the army's equipment and uniforms.
texts.程普在江东称自己可自带约五百名精锐甲士及十数舸小舟随行。: Cheng Pu in Jiangdong stated he could bring about 500 elite armored soldiers and roughly a dozen small boats to accompany him.
texts.程普在江东称若按现编制，可于三日内集结并出发。: Cheng Pu in Jiangdong said that at the current organization he could assemble and set out within three days.
texts.程普在江东称若需将兵力扩编至千人，则需五至七日时间筹集增员。: Cheng Pu in Jiangdong said that if the force needed to be expanded to 1,000 men, five to seven days would be required to gather the additional troops.
texts.程普在江东请张昭具奏并示行路引與出发期日，称闻令即行，收到行路引和出发期日便会出: Cheng Pu in Jiangdong asked Zhang Zhao to formally present the petition and to provide the travel authorization and departure date, stating he would depart immediately upon receipt of them.
texts.程普在江东集结十余舸小舟。: Cheng Pu in Jiangdong assembled more than ten small boats.
texts.程普在演说中进行当前形势评估，指出敌情严峻且敌军活动频繁，威胁江东海防与后方补给: In his speech Cheng Pu assessed the situation, noting severe and frequent enemy activity that threatened Jiangdong's coastal defense and rear supply lines.
texts.程普在面陈中列明突发来袭与被重围时的初步处置要点，以便前线能迅速应对与撤换阵地。: In his memorial Cheng Pu listed initial procedures for handling sudden attacks and being heavily encircled so the front could respond rapidly and change positions.
texts.程普在面陈中特别强调粮运为江东持久防守的要害，要求建立可靠的粮食储运与护运体系。: In his memorial Cheng Pu emphasized that grain transport was vital to Jiangdong's sustained defense and required establishing a reliable system of grain storage, transport, and convoy protection.
texts.程普建议固守会稽及沿海要冲，主张通过要塞布防与合理配置守备兵力来巩固防线。: Cheng Pu recommended holding Kuaiji and coastal strongpoints, advocating fortifying bastions and reasonably allocating garrison forces to consolidate the defensive line.
texts.程普建议屯粮与掌运，措施包括沿海粮仓建设、护运舟队编配以及粮饷调拨的备案制度。: Cheng Pu proposed stockpiling grain and controlling transport, including building coastal granaries, organizing convoy boat flotillas, and establishing record-keeping for grain and pay transfers.
texts.程普建议沿海守备基线应配置二千守备兵，并保有主力战舟三十艘作为海防骨干力量。: Cheng Pu proposed that the coastal defense baseline be manned by 2,000 garrison troops and that 30 main warships be maintained as the backbone of maritime defense.
texts.程普建议联络江东豪族以稳固后方，提出招抚授任并与豪族订立合约以换取人力与粮草支持: Cheng Pu suggested contacting Jiangdong's powerful families to secure the rear, proposing to recruit and appoint them and to make contracts with those families in exchange for manpower and provisions.
texts.程普提出如需扩编或情势急迫，应按行路引或引见顺序优先执行扩编与紧急出征程序。: Cheng Pu proposed that if forces needed expansion or the situation became urgent, the procedures for expansion and emergency dispatch should be prioritized according to travel authorization or audience order.
texts.程普提出设烽警与沿海巡哨的安排，具体包括沿海哨点建设、夜间巡航与联络通信线的建立: Cheng Pu proposed establishing beacon alarms and coastal patrols, specifically building coastal watch posts, conducting night patrols, and creating lines of communication.
texts.程普督促将士在三日内备齐并出发。: Cheng Pu urged the soldiers to assemble and depart within three days.
texts.程普结语恳请孙权署命或颁行路引，并声明若迅速颁行路引，程普将即刻动身执行所陈方案: In conclusion Cheng Pu earnestly asked Sun Quan to sign an order or issue the travel authorization, and stated that if the authorization were issued promptly he would immediately set out to carry out the proposed plan.
texts.程普自称可率约五百名精锐甲士与十余舸小舟为随行部队，并表示三日内可集结出发。: Cheng Pu claimed he could lead about 500 elite armored soldiers and more than ten small boats as his accompanying force, and said he could assemble and depart within three days.
texts.程普與太史慈已回示「無異」，且兩人偏好由張昭先引見孫權以正名其任命。: Cheng Pu and Taishi Ci replied 'no objection', and both preferred that Zhang Zhao first present them to Sun Quan to legitimize their appointments.
texts.程普评估江东的薄弱处为海防漏洞、沿海守备不足以及粮运线的脆弱性，需优先补强。: Cheng Pu assessed Jiangdong's weaknesses as gaps in coastal defense, insufficient coastal garrisons, and fragile grain transport lines that need priority reinforcement.
texts.程普请孙权赐韩当、黄盖为随臣佐将，并赋予二人必要权令以利军令统一與统筹行动。: Cheng Pu requested that Sun Quan grant Han Dang and Huang Gai positions as attendant officers and give them the necessary authority to unify military orders and coordinate operations.
texts.程普请张昭引见孙权以取得署命，或先呈表付行路引，声明闻令即行准备出发。: Cheng Pu asked Zhang Zhao to present him to Sun Quan to obtain official authorization, or to first submit the memorial to receive the travel authorization, declaring he would depart upon hearing the order.
texts.程普请张昭引见孙权，以便韩当和黄盖取得名分和官职。: Cheng Pu asked Zhang Zhao to present him to Sun Quan so that Han Dang and Huang Gai could obtain rank and official posts.
texts.程普请求随行兵力为五百精锐并配备十余舸，以便快速行动与应对初期交战需要。: Cheng Pu requested accompanying forces of 500 elite troops and more than ten small boats to enable rapid action and meet initial combat needs.
texts.第一策：即刻封固外门、加固城墙，并置弩兵昼夜轮换守备。: Plan One: Immediately seal the outer gates, reinforce the city walls, and station crossbowmen on day-and-night rotational guard.
texts.第三策：主力据城中隘口与内城要点布防，设精锐预备队以便应变。: Third strategy: Position the main force to defend the city's narrow passes and key inner-city points, and establish an elite reserve for rapid response.
texts.第三路由于禁率領，方向為博陵渡口一帶進行偵察。: The third column, led by Yue Jin, is conducting reconnaissance in the area of the Boling ferry.
texts.第二策：抽调轻骑分三路出城侦察、断敌粮道，并在必经要道设伏。: Second strategy: Detach light cavalry in three columns to sally out for reconnaissance, to cut the enemy's grain routes, and to set ambushes on必经要道 (key thoroughfares).
texts.第二路由樂進率領，方向為濮陽進行偵察。: The second column, led by Yue Jin, is conducting reconnaissance toward Puyang.
texts.第五策：令荀彧与程昱密察敌情并速报，且允准程昱暗中核实徐庶和徐庶的母亲之事以图贤: Fifth strategy: Order Xun Yu and Cheng Yu to secretly observe enemy conditions and report quickly, and permit Cheng Yu to covertly verify matters concerning Xu Shu and Xu Shu's mother to try to win the scholar's allegiance.
texts.第四策：即刻清点军器与粮饷，并严防军中情报或补给外泄。: Fourth strategy: Immediately inventory weapons and soldiers' pay, and strictly prevent military intelligence or supply leaks from the army.
texts.箭上拴着的密信恳请曹操闻讯后速来救援。: A secret letter attached to an arrow pleaded with Cao Cao to come quickly to the rescue upon receiving the news.
texts.箭上拴着的密信载明了吕布军哨卡的布置与大致兵力部署。: A secret letter attached to an arrow detailed the placement of Lu Bu's sentry posts and the general troop dispositions.
texts.糜竺与仓曹负责整理逐仓封存数量与护库人名，并将整理结果上呈给刘备。: Mi Zhu and the warehouse officer are responsible for cataloguing the quantities sealed in each granary and the names of the storehouse guards, and will present the results to Liu Bei.
texts.糜竺与府主簿将向刘备报告初拟拨款额度与主簿姓名。: Mi Zhu and the prefectural registrar will report to Liu Bei the initially proposed allocation amounts and the registrar's name(s).
texts.糜竺与府主簿被指派共同负责监督上述拨付并登记留账。: Mi Zhu and the prefectural registrar are appointed jointly to supervise the above disbursements and to record them in the accounts.
texts.糜竺准许孙乾在逐项盘点精核到手前分批先行拨发优先项，首要拨发粮草與兵饷。: Mi Zhu permitted Sun Qian to disburse priority items in batches before the itemized verification was fully completed, with the primary disbursements being grain and soldiers' pay.
texts.糜竺列出樊城粮仓的现有可用容积。: Mi Zhu listed the current usable capacity of Fancheng's granaries.
texts.糜竺列明负责各项管库与拨款的负责人及其职责分配。: Mi Zhu specified the persons responsible for each warehouse and allocation and their assigned duties.
texts.糜竺向刘备承诺将在十五分钟内呈报逐项精确的盘点单。: Mi Zhu promised Liu Bei that he would present a precise itemized inventory within fifteen minutes.
texts.糜竺在准许孙乾分批拨发时同时允许先行拨发次要军需物资，如弓弩與箭矢。: When allowing Sun Qian to disburse in batches, Mi Zhu also authorized advance disbursement of secondary military supplies, such as bows, crossbows, and arrows.
texts.糜竺在樊城动用府库临时拨银，优先保障全军一个月的口粮与兵饷，并与府主簿共同监督拨: In Fancheng, Mi Zhu tapped the prefectural treasury for a temporary cash allocation, prioritizing one month's rations and soldiers' pay for the entire army, and jointly supervised the disbursement and accounting with the prefectural registrar.
texts.糜竺在樊城命令仓曹立刻封存樊城各仓的粮草，並向刘备回报该命令的执行情况。: In Fancheng, Mi Zhu ordered the warehouse officer to immediately seal the grain in each storehouse of Fancheng and to report back to Liu Bei on the execution of the order.
texts.糜竺在樊城着手征调附近郡县的粮草，并拟定将粮草护送到仓库的护送方案。: In Fancheng, Mi Zhu began requisitioning grain from nearby commanderies and counties and drafted a convoy plan to escort the grain to the granaries.
texts.糜竺报告樊城的兵饷余额与每月需用数额。: Mi Zhu reported Fancheng's remaining balance of soldiers' pay and the monthly required amount.
texts.糜竺报告樊城的弹药数量与消耗率。: Mi Zhu reported the quantity of ammunition in Fancheng and its consumption rate.
texts.糜竺报告樊城的武器与甲胄存量及可装备人数。: Mi Zhu reported the stock of weapons and armor in Fancheng and the number of men they could equip.
texts.糜竺指出樊城当前紧缺的物资清单。: Mi Zhu pointed out Fancheng's current list of urgently needed supplies.
texts.糜竺提出樊城物资的优先补给顺序。: Mi Zhu proposed the priority resupply order for Fancheng's supplies.
texts.糜竺逐项列出樊城的粮草总量与日均消耗。: Mi Zhu itemized Fancheng's total grain and forage supplies and the average daily consumption.
texts.缺口物资清单优先调拨辎重马匹约40匹及若干辎重车与重弩维修零件。: The shortage list prioritizes allocating about 40 baggage horses and several supply wagons and spare parts for heavy crossbow repairs.
texts.缺口物资清单优先调拨重弩约30架。: The shortage list prioritizes allocating about 30 heavy crossbows.
texts.缺口物资清单已标注乐进为点收与调拨责任人。: The shortage list has designated Yue Jin as the person responsible for receipt and allocation.
texts.若太史慈将兵力增至七百人，则需五至七日方可集结完毕。: If Taishi Ci increases his force to 700 men, it will take five to seven days to complete the muster.
texts.若孙策当日不得会见张昭，张昭将先将荐表呈于孙策并颁发行路引。: If Sun Ce cannot meet Zhang Zhao that day, Zhang Zhao will first present the recommendation form to Sun Ce and issue travel passes.
texts.若张绣不便亲至，蔡瑁要求先与张绣的幕僚或代表在馆驿等偏僻处秘密接洽。: If Zhang Xiu is unable to come in person, Cai Mao requests to first meet secretly with Zhang Xiu's staff or representatives at remote guesthouses or relay stations.
texts.若徐母家书认证为真实，张辽和夏侯惇秘密安排接应与短期安置徐庶并以礼遇稳住徐庶。: If the letter from Xu Shu's mother is authenticated as genuine, Zhang Liao and Xiahou Dun will secretly arrange to receive and temporarily house Xu Shu and will treat Xu Shu with courtesy to keep him placated.
texts.若许昌守备遇敌，守备被命令即刻速报并连夜回奏给指挥部。: If Xuchang's garrison encounters the enemy, the garrison is ordered to report immediately and to send a night dispatch to the command headquarters.
texts.若赵云需撤离，许褚指定南河桥作为赵云的临时接应点。: If Zhao Yun needs to withdraw, Xu Chu designates the South River Bridge as Zhao Yun's temporary rendezvous point.
texts.荀彧与程昱代曹操草拟了一封召徐庶的书信。: Xun Yu and Cheng Yu drafted a letter on behalf of Cao Cao to summon Xu Shu.
texts.荀彧与程昱代曹操草拟的书信中暗示会优待徐庶。: The letter Xun Yu and Cheng Yu drafted for Cao Cao implies that Xu Shu will be treated favorably.
texts.荀彧与程昱回报，徐庶之母已安全安置于许昌。: Xun Yu and Cheng Yu reported that Xu Shu's mother has been safely placed in Xuchang.
texts.荀彧与程昱将统筹各部逐项明细并在半刻内整合入许昌防务初稿，呈送都督与陛下裁示。: Xun Yu and Cheng Yu will coordinate detailed reports from each department and, within half a ke, integrate them into a draft Xuchang defense plan to submit to the commander and the Emperor for instructions.
texts.荀彧向汉献帝及群臣回报：他将统筹汇总各将的上述报告并上呈陛下。: Xun Yu reported to Emperor Xian of Han and the court that he will coordinate and compile the above reports from the generals and present them to His Majesty.
texts.荀彧向汉献帝及群臣回报：他已命侦骑昼夜速报敌情。: Xun Yu reported to Emperor Xian of Han and the court that he has ordered scouts to report enemy activity day and night.
texts.荀彧向汉献帝及群臣回报：他已命侦骑遇敌即刻鸣钟并入奏报备。: Xun Yu reported to Emperor Xian of Han and the court that he has ordered scouts to sound the bell immediately upon encountering the enemy and to file a formal report.
texts.荀彧向汉献帝及群臣回报：他已责令各将立即逐项明报可出动守城的兵数。: Xun Yu reported to Emperor Xian of Han and the court that he has ordered all generals to immediately report, item by item, the numbers of troops available to defend the city.
texts.荀彧向汉献帝及群臣回报：他已责令各将立即逐项明报可出动巡逻的兵数。: Xun Yu reported to Emperor Xian of Han and the court that he has ordered all generals to immediately report, item by item, the numbers of troops available for patrols.
texts.荀彧向汉献帝及群臣回报：他已责令各将逐项列出短缺项并列明所需援军与预计到援时点。: Xun Yu reported to Emperor Xian of Han and the court that he has ordered all generals to list shortages item by item and to state the reinforcements needed and the expected arrival times.
texts.荀彧向汉献帝及群臣回报：他已责令各将逐项明报现有兵器余量。: Xun Yu reported to Emperor Xian of Han and the court that he has ordered all generals to report, item by item, their current stocks of weapons.
texts.荀彧向汉献帝及群臣回报：他已责令各将逐项明报现有粮饷余量。: Xun Yu reported to Emperor Xian of Han and the court that he has ordered all generals to report, item by item, their current supplies of grain and provisions.
texts.荀彧命乐进即刻派精兵昼夜把守主仓，严防内应与私运。: Xun Yu ordered Yue Jin to immediately dispatch elite troops to guard the main granary day and night, strictly preventing insider collusion and private transport.
texts.荀彧命令乐进立即清点许昌主仓与分储的谷帛实存，包括谷帛数量和可用粮袋数量。: Xun Yu ordered Yue Jin to immediately inventory the actual stocks of grain and cloth in Xuchang's main granary and satellite storehouses, including the quantity of grain and cloth and the number of usable grain sacks.
texts.荀彧命令乐进逐项列明所有军器品目，并标注每一项的短缺数量。: Xun Yu ordered Yue Jin to list all categories of military equipment item by item and to note the shortage quantity for each.
texts.荀彧命各将于一时辰内逐项明报三路侦骑与巡逻队可出动人数、拟定路线与当前驻点。: Xun Yu ordered all generals to, within one shichen, report item by item the numbers of troops available to dispatch for the three routes of scouts and patrols, the planned routes, and their current positions.
texts.荀彧命各将于一时辰内逐项明报各垛口弩手到位人数。: Xun Yu ordered all generals to, within one shichen, report item by item the number of crossbowmen stationed at each parapet position.
texts.荀彧命各将于一时辰内逐项明报各粮仓（主仓与分储）谷帛实存数、可用粮袋数、短缺项及: Xun Yu ordered all generals to, within one shichen, report item by item the actual stocks of grain and cloth in each granary (main and satellite), the number of usable grain sacks, shortages, and the expected arrival times for reinforcements.
texts.荀彧命各将于一时辰内逐项明报各队联络官姓名与当前驻点坐标。: Xun Yu ordered all generals to, within one shichen, report item by item the names of each unit's liaison officers and their current station coordinates.
texts.荀彧命各将如遇可疑内应须即行收押并将收押情况上奏。: Xun Yu ordered all generals that if they encounter suspected insider collaborators they must immediately detain them and submit reports of the detentions.
texts.荀彧和程昱被命令密察敌情并迅速向刘协报告。: Xun Yu and Cheng Yu were ordered to conduct clandestine reconnaissance of the enemy and to report swiftly to Liu Xie.
texts.荀彧在许昌把各路回报汇总成许昌防务首版部署建议。: In Xuchang, Xun Yu consolidated the reports from all routes into a first-draft deployment proposal for Xuchang's defense.
texts.荀彧将统筹汇总各位将领的回奏并上呈陛下。: Xun Yu will coordinate and compile the generals' reports and present them to His Majesty.
texts.荀彧要求乐进在一时辰内以书面形式回报清点與核查結果，并将书面报告呈报给荀彧、张辽: Xun Yu ordered Yue Jin to, within one shichen, submit in writing the results of the inventory and verification, and to present the written report to Xun Yu, Zhang Liao, and Cheng Yu.
texts.草拟呈报孙权的奏折：详列江夏水师当前缺损与所需补给（战船修缮、橹桨更换、连桩加固: Draft memorial to submit to Sun Quan: detail the current deficiencies and required supplies of the Jiangxia naval force (warship repairs, replacement oars and paddles, reinforcement of pile connections, oil fuels and burners
texts.荐表中将韩当与黄盖列为随臣佐将。: In the recommendation list, Han Dang and Huang Gai are listed as attendant aides and assisting generals.
texts.荐表中载明，准许程普率领五百精锐随行。: The recommendation document stated permission for Cheng Pu to lead five hundred elite troops to accompany.
texts.获确认后，许褚一方士兵按折布低举与低声口令分批入城并隐蔽驻守。: After confirmation, Xu Chu's soldiers entered the city in batches, raising folded cloth and using low-voice commands, then concealed themselves to garrison.
texts.蔡瑁下令襄阳西门以檀溪为屏障，不需设哨。: Cai Mao ordered that Xiangyang's west gate be protected by Tanxi as a barrier and that no sentries be posted.
texts.蔡瑁交代薄礼应为小函以示诚意，不宜贵重。: Cai Mao instructed that the small gift should be a small box to show sincerity and should not be valuable.
texts.蔡瑁交代館舍門吏與外城探子一有消息就回報並前來向贾诩禀告。: Cai Mao instructed the lodging gatekeepers and outer-city scouts to report any news and come to inform Jia Xu.
texts.蔡瑁向贾诩禀报并拟定一套用于验明与会人员身份与意向的会面策划。: Cai Mao reported to Jia Xu and devised a set of meeting procedures to verify attendees' identities and intentions.
texts.蔡瑁命令五百伏兵分作数股，潜伏在馆舍周围和外城门的隐蔽要点。: Cai Mao ordered the five hundred ambushers to be divided into several groups to lie in ambush around the lodgings and at concealed key points of the outer city gates.
texts.蔡瑁命令蔡中驻守襄阳南门。: Cai Mao ordered Cai Zhong to garrison Xiangyang's south gate.
texts.蔡瑁命令蔡勋驻守襄阳北门。: Cai Mao ordered Cai Xun to garrison Xiangyang's north gate.
texts.蔡瑁命令蔡和驻守襄阳东门。: Cai Mao ordered Cai He to garrison Xiangyang's east gate.
texts.蔡瑁命令被抽调的五百精兵随时待命，必要时配合蒯越和蔡瑁的夫人行动。: Cai Mao ordered the drafted five hundred elite soldiers to remain on alert at all times and, when necessary, to act in coordination with Kuai Yue and Mrs. Cai.
texts.蔡瑁命令館舍門吏與外城探子暗中查訪張繡的下落。: Cai Mao ordered the lodging gatekeepers and outer-city scouts to secretly investigate Zhang Xiu's whereabouts.
texts.蔡瑁命令馆舍门吏与外城探子以约定暗号待命。: Cai Mao ordered the lodging gatekeepers and outer-city scouts to stand by using an agreed secret code.
texts.蔡瑁命令馆舍门吏与外城探子在接到蒯越或蔡夫人的行动信号时即刻出动。: Cai Mao ordered the lodging gatekeepers and outer-city scouts to mobilize immediately upon receiving an action signal from Kuai Yue or Mrs. Cai.
texts.蔡瑁在襄阳命令暗探暗中物色一处安全会面地点。: In Xiangyang, Cai Mao ordered undercover agents to clandestinely select a secure meeting location.
texts.蔡瑁在襄阳回复贾诩，称已嘱暗探若得张绣所在必速禀报。: In Xiangyang, Cai Mao replied to Jia Xu that he had instructed undercover agents to report immediately if they discovered Zhang Xiu's whereabouts.
texts.蔡瑁在襄阳拟定并通报给贾诩一套验明会面措施。: In Xiangyang, Cai Mao drafted and notified Jia Xu of a set of measures to verify meeting participants.
texts.蔡瑁在襄阳指示暗探备薄礼以示对张绣的诚意。: In Xiangyang, Cai Mao instructed undercover agents to prepare a small gift to show sincerity toward Zhang Xiu.
texts.蔡瑁在襄阳派遣兩名暗探前往張繡可能去處打探行蹤。: In Xiangyang, Cai Mao dispatched two undercover agents to possible places Zhang Xiu might go to investigate his movements.
texts.蔡瑁在襄阳要求暗探一旦落定会面地点与安排即刻禀报贾诩。: In Xiangyang, Cai Mao required undercover agents to report to Jia Xu immediately once the meeting place and arrangements were finalized.
texts.蔡瑁在襄陽向賈詡禀報行動進展。: In Xiangyang, Cai Mao reported the progress of operations to Jia Xu.
texts.蔡瑁已暗中物色安全會面地點，以便與張繡或張繡代表接觸。: Cai Mao has secretly selected a secure meeting location to contact Zhang Xiu or Zhang Xiu's representative.
texts.蔡瑁指定蒯越或蔡夫人作为发出行动信号的人员。: Cai Mao designated Kuai Yue or Mrs. Cai as the persons authorized to send the action signal.
texts.蔡瑁指示五百伏兵中安插隐蔽哨兵与联络兵。: Cai Mao instructed that concealed sentries and liaison soldiers be placed among the five hundred ambushers.
texts.蔡瑁指示暗探使用暗语“薄礼已备”与识物并用，作为试探对方身份与意向的口令。: Cai Mao instructed undercover agents to use the password "small gift ready" along with an object for recognition as a test of the other's identity and intent.
texts.蔡瑁指示暗探在接触目标时以折叠白布一角作为识别信物。: Cai Mao instructed undercover agents to use a folded corner of white cloth as an identification token when contacting the target.
texts.蔡瑁指示若会面出现异常或疑为诱敌，暗探必须速撤并以约定信号向贾诩回报。: Cai Mao instructed that if the meeting appeared abnormal or suspected to be a trap, the undercover agents must withdraw quickly and report to Jia Xu using the agreed signal.
texts.蔡瑁指示若有風聲草動，應立刻將情況傳報給贾诩。: Cai Mao instructed that any sign of trouble should be reported immediately to Jia Xu.
texts.蔡瑁是刘表的妻弟，任荆州水军统领，立场倾向主张归附曹操。: Cai Mao is Liu Biao's brother-in-law, serves as commander of Jing Province's naval forces, and favors submitting to Cao Cao.
texts.蔡瑁表示一有張繡的著落就會來向賈詡禀告。: Cai Mao said he would report to Jia Xu as soon as he had news of Zhang Xiu's whereabouts.
texts.蔡瑁要求会面地点应选择出入可控且便于暗中布防之处。: Cai Mao requires meeting locations to be chosen with controllable access and convenient for covertly deploying defenses.
texts.蔡瑁要求所获一切情报或会面結果即刻禀报于贾诩。: Cai Mao requires that all obtained intelligence or meeting outcomes be reported immediately to Jia Xu.
texts.蔡瑁要求暗探先暗中试探目标人员与目标来意，确认目标人与意向后再安排正式会面。: Cai Mao requires scouts to first secretly probe the target person and the target's intent, and only arrange a formal meeting after confirming the person and intent.
texts.蔡瑁规定以折叠白布一角作为信物，用以确认张绣的身份。: Cai Mao stipulates using a corner of folded white cloth as a token to confirm Zhang Xiu's identity.
texts.蔡瑁规定以暗语“薄礼已备”作为验明张绣身份的口令。: Cai Mao stipulates using the code phrase "A small gift has been prepared" as the password to verify Zhang Xiu's identity.
texts.蔡瑁设定两条撤退与封锁通道并命令伏兵熟悉相关地形。: Cai Mao establishes two retreat and blockade routes and orders ambush troops to become familiar with the related terrain.
texts.薦表記載程普率水軍隨行五百人，該編制可擴至一千人，擴編需五至七日時間。: The recommendation record states Cheng Pu will lead 500 naval troops; this force can be expanded to 1,000, and expansion requires five to seven days.
texts.行动中引导与掩护分为两队。: During the operation, guides and covering forces are divided into two teams.
texts.行路引要求行前三日入報實數備查。: The marching orders require the actual numbers to be reported three days before departure for record.
texts.行路引要求赴行前嚴檢舵具水手火攻器材之完備。: The marching orders require a strict inspection before departure of steering gear, sailors, and fire-attack equipment.
texts.行路引規定先行簽發三日行軍糧並標定沿途補給點與護運路線。: The marching orders require issuing three days' marching rations in advance and designating en route supply points and transport escort routes.
texts.行路引規定太史慈之親衛五十須列明護衛名單並辦理勤務交接。: The marching orders require Taishi Ci's fifty personal guards to have a listed guard roster and to complete duty handover procedures.
texts.行路引規定會稽須預置二百兵且地方糧儲須通令縣郡協助。: The marching orders require Kuaiji to pre-position 200 soldiers, and local grain stores must be ordered to have counties and commanderies assist.
texts.行路引規定沿途要所預置小股護衛以防內怠。: The marching orders require small detachments of guards to be stationed at key points along the route to prevent internal laxity.
texts.行路引規定程普所部主力戰舟與護運舟隨行，黃蓋督造整治戰艦備火器。: The marching orders stipulate Cheng Pu's main combat boats and transport escort boats will accompany the force, and Huang Gai will supervise construction and repair of warships and prepare fire weapons.
texts.行路引規定若以五百為準三日內集結完畢，擴編需五至七日且火器舟艘糧餉同時具足。: If set at 500, the force can assemble within three days; expansion requires five to seven days and fire weapons, boats, and provisions/pay must all be ready simultaneously.
texts.行路引規定若遇敵變或交通阻滯，督軍得即行調度會稽預置二百互援並即呈報孫策重大變故: If an enemy change or transportation obstruction occurs, the commanding general may immediately redeploy Kuaiji's pre-positioned 200 for mutual support and must immediately report major developments to Sun Ce.
texts.行路引規定行軍路線避險要道，夜行嚴控哨夜，船隊按隊形行進並設護運分隊。: The marching orders stipulate the route avoid dangerous passes, night marches must strictly control sentries, fleets proceed in formation, and transport escort detachments must be established.
texts.行路引規定設烽警哨所與聯絡儀式，軍令統一由督軍與主將發出，副將遵令。: Establish beacon warning posts and communication procedures; military orders are to be issued uniformly by the commanding general and the principal commander, and deputy commanders shall obey.
texts.行路引規定集結地點為各部於本府受命之營屯集合，太史慈與程普各自於所屬營門集結。: The assembly point is for each unit to gather at the camp assigned by this headquarters; Taishi Ci and Cheng Pu will each assemble at the gates of their respective camps.
texts.被孙乾派出的10至20名轻骑正在对夏侯惇的部队执行侦察任务，侦察行动正在进行中。: Ten to twenty light cavalry sent by Sun Qian are conducting reconnaissance against Xiahou Dun's forces; the reconnaissance is currently in progress.
texts.親衛五十名額預留，張昭會同太史慈與程普薦介，或由孫策親定。: A quota of fifty personal guards is reserved; Zhang Zhao together with Taishi Ci and Cheng Pu will recommend candidates, or Sun Ce may decide personally.
texts.计划允许五名先遣亲兵先行接应，但须事前报姓名与出发时间。: The plan permits five advance personal guards to go ahead to provide reception, but they must report their names and departure times in advance.
texts.计策中备有乐进受阻或遇害时的应急撤回与替换方案以保护行动安全。: The plan includes contingency withdrawal and replacement procedures should Yue Jin be blocked or killed, to protect the operation's safety.
texts.计策中备有反间方案以应对敌方反间行动针对徐庶召回行动。: The plan includes a counter-espionage scheme to respond to enemy counter-intelligence actions aimed at recalling Xu Shu.
texts.许昌各处须在一时辰内呈初报，初报包括南北东西四门守备、巡逻与侦骑兵数、粮饷军器余: All parts of Xuchang must present an initial report within one shichen; the initial report must include defenses of the four gates (north, south, east, west), numbers of patrols and scout cavalry, remaining and shortages of rations and military equipment, and the names of liaison officers.
texts.许昌后勤要求迅速清点军器與粮饷并编制清单以便调配与补给。: Xuchang logistics require a rapid inventory of arms and rations and the compilation of a list for allocation and resupply.
texts.许昌四门各配备四十名弩手并实行昼夜轮换值守门口防务。: Each of Xuchang's four gates is assigned forty crossbowmen and implements day-and-night rotating duty to guard the gate.
texts.许昌城东门守备约160人。: Approximately 160 men garrison the east gate of Xuchang.
texts.许昌城内的守备被命令在日出与日落各报一次。: The garrison inside Xuchang is ordered to report once at sunrise and once at sunset.
texts.许昌城内防守方案规定在南门、北门、东门和西门各设两营步卒驻防。: Xuchang's defense plan requires two infantry camps to garrison each of the south, north, east, and west gates.
texts.许昌城北门守备约160人。: About 160 men garrison the north gate of Xuchang.
texts.许昌城南门守备约160人。: About 160 men garrison the south gate of Xuchang.
texts.许昌城四门垛口弩手每处约40人。: About 40 crossbowmen at the battlements of each of Xuchang's four gates.
texts.许昌城西门守备约160人。: About 160 men garrison the west gate of Xuchang.
texts.许昌布防并设立精锐预备队作为后备力量。: Xuchang deployed defenses and established an elite reserve unit as a backup force.
texts.许昌的主力军据城中隘口与要点布防。: Xuchang's main army was deployed at the city's choke points and key positions.
texts.许昌防务初稿列出三路轻骑的各路联络官姓名与各驻点坐标。: The initial Xuchang defense draft lists the names of liaison officers for the three light-cavalry routes and the coordinates of each station.
texts.许昌防务初稿载明三路轻骑的部署情况。: The initial Xuchang defense draft specifies the deployment of the three light-cavalry routes.
texts.许昌防务初稿载明四门守备各约160人。: The initial Xuchang defense draft states that each of the four gates is defended by about 160 men.
texts.许褚亲自带领十名精兵前往新野南门外。: Xu Chu personally led ten elite soldiers to outside the south gate of Xinye.
texts.许褚亲自率领引导小队，负责先行开路进入城内。: Xu Chu personally led the guide squad responsible for going ahead to open the way into the city.
texts.许褚亲自领引他所派出的十名精兵，十人分为两队负责引导和掩护。: Xu Chu personally led the ten elite soldiers he dispatched; the ten were divided into two teams responsible for guiding and covering.
texts.许褚准许赵云遣五名亲兵先行接应城内。: Xu Chu permitted Zhao Yun to send five personal guards to go ahead and support inside the city.
texts.许褚向张飞、赵云与诸葛亮发出最终确认请求，要求就夜袭行动做最后确认。: Xu Chu sent a final confirmation request to Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, and Zhuge Liang asking for final confirmation of the night raid.
texts.许褚在新野回报允准赵云入城暂驻。: Xu Chu reported at Xinye that he approved Zhao Yun to enter the city and temporarily station there.
texts.许褚在新野回报建议派人暗中引领赵云并布置接应哨位。: Xu Chu reported at Xinye recommending sending people to secretly guide Zhao Yun and to deploy support sentry positions.
texts.许褚在新野回报说城中守备不足。: Xu Chu reported at Xinye that the city's garrison was insufficient.
texts.许褚指定掩护队队长为张勇，副队长为陈武。: Xu Chu designated Zhang Yong as captain of the covering team and Chen Wu as deputy captain.
texts.许褚指定撤退集合地点为南河桥。: Xu Chu designated South River Bridge as the retreat rally point.
texts.许褚指定的入城后暂驻地点为南门东侧的旧仓库或客栈。: Xu Chu designated the temporary lodging after entering the city as the old granary or the inn east of the south gate.
texts.许褚指定的入城集合点是南门外正南三丈处的大槐树。: Xu Chu designated the assembly point outside the south gate as the large locust tree located three zhang directly to the south.
texts.许褚指示张飞在夜袭中主攻。: Xu Chu instructed Zhang Fei to lead the main attack in the night raid.
texts.许褚指示赵云在夜袭中负责截断敌军。: Xu Chu instructed Zhao Yun to be responsible for cutting off the enemy during the night raid.
texts.许褚指示这十名精兵预计约十五分钟到位。: Xu Chu indicated that these ten elite soldiers were expected to be in position in about fifteen minutes.
texts.许褚核实了赵云私下呈报给他的情报。: Xu Chu verified the intelligence Zhao Yun privately reported to him.
texts.许褚派出十名掩护人员，掩护首领为张勇、副手为陈武，并命令他们在十五分钟内到位。: Xu Chu dispatched ten covering personnel, with cover leader Zhang Yong and deputy Chen Wu, and ordered them to be in position within fifteen minutes.
texts.许褚派出十名掩护精兵到位作为掩护力量。: Xu Chu sent ten elite covering soldiers to be in position as a covering force.
texts.许褚派出十名掩护精兵前来掩护夜袭行动。: Xu Chu sent ten elite covering soldiers to come and cover the night raid.
texts.许褚派出十名精兵前往掩护赵云在新野的暂时驻留。: Xu Chu dispatched ten elite soldiers to cover Zhao Yun's temporary stay in Xinye.
texts.许褚请张飞、赵云与诸葛亮回复“同意”或提出异议。: Xu Chu asked Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, and Zhuge Liang to respond 'agree' or to raise objections.
texts.该初稿列明城垛弩手配置与守卫站位细则。: The initial draft specified the deployment of battlement crossbowmen and detailed guard posting rules.
texts.该建议编制三路轻骑兵各约100人作为机动部队。: The proposal organized three columns of light cavalry, about 100 men each, as a mobile force.
texts.该建议规定许昌城墙各垛口配约40名弩手。: The proposal stipulated assigning about 40 crossbowmen to each battlement opening on the Xuchang city walls.
texts.诸葛亮、张飞、赵云与许褚在新野商议后达成作战决定。: Zhuge Liang, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, and Xu Chu met in Xinye and, after discussion, reached a military decision.
texts.诸葛亮下令派出数十名轻骑侦察曹军主力及其补给线。: Zhuge Liang ordered dozens of light cavalry to scout the Cao army's main force and its supply lines.
texts.诸葛亮与各位将领约定夜袭的集合地点与集合时间。: Zhuge Liang and the generals agreed on the rendezvous point and time for the night raid.
texts.诸葛亮与各位将领设定烽火与鼓声为夜袭与撤退的信号。: Zhuge Liang and the generals set beacon fires and drumbeats as signals for the night raid and for retreat.
texts.诸葛亮与各将确定了夜袭的集合地点和撤退路线以便会合和撤离。: Zhuge Liang and the generals finalized the night-raid rendezvous point and the retreat route to facilitate assembly and withdrawal.
texts.诸葛亮令许褚镇守城门并统领城中主力防守。: Zhuge Liang ordered Xu Chu to garrison the city gates and to command the city's main defensive force.
texts.诸葛亮同意按照许褚提出的预案实施夜袭行动。: Zhuge Liang agreed to carry out the night raid according to Xu Chu's proposed plan.
texts.诸葛亮命张飞率精锐数百人在夜间袭击曹军先锋。: Zhuge Liang ordered Zhang Fei to lead several hundred elite troops to attack the Cao army vanguard at night.
texts.诸葛亮在新野与许褚、张飞、赵云会面，三人就当前军事形势进行商议。: Zhuge Liang met in Xinye with Xu Chu, Zhang Fei, and Zhao Yun; the three discussed the current military situation.
texts.诸葛亮在新野向刘备等人建议以守为要。: In Xinye, Zhuge Liang advised Liu Bei and others that defense should be the priority.
texts.诸葛亮在新野向刘备等人建议借水阻敌。: In Xinye, Zhuge Liang advised Liu Bei and others to use water to obstruct the enemy.
texts.诸葛亮在新野向刘备等人建议备足粮草。: In Xinye, Zhuge Liang advised Liu Bei and others to stock sufficient grain and forage.
texts.诸葛亮在新野向刘备等人建议寻求援兵。: In Xinye, Zhuge Liang advised Liu Bei and others to seek reinforcements.
texts.诸葛亮在新野向刘备等人建议择险要布伏。: In Xinye, Zhuge Liang advised Liu Bei and others to select strategic strongpoints to set ambushes.
texts.诸葛亮在新野向刘备等人建议派精兵侦察敌情。: In Xinye, Zhuge Liang advised Liu Bei and others to send elite troops to scout the enemy situation.
texts.诸葛亮在新野向刘备等人建议立即整顿城防。: In Xinye, Zhuge Liang advised Liu Bei and others to immediately reorganize the city's defenses.
texts.诸葛亮建议在险要处布伏或借助水利阻敌，利用地形和水域遏制敌军推进。: Zhuge Liang proposed ambushing at key points or using waterworks to block the enemy, using terrain and waterways to halt the enemy's advance.
texts.诸葛亮指派张飞率领数百名精锐士兵夜袭曹军先锋，目标是速战速撤。: Zhuge Liang assigned Zhang Fei to lead several hundred elite soldiers in a night attack on the Cao army vanguard, aiming for a quick strike-and-withdraw.
texts.诸葛亮督促各部整编完毕并即刻出发执行夜袭计划。: Zhuge Liang urged all units to finish reorganizing and to depart immediately to execute the night-raid plan.
texts.貂蝉在王允府内寻访王允，入画阁呼唤，未见王允在场。: Diao Chan searched for Wang Yun in Wang Yun's residence, entered the painting pavilion and called out, but Wang Yun was not there.
texts.贾诩在襄阳命蔡瑁开一条隐蔽通道以便贾诩能够轻装入内会面。: In Xiangyang, Jia Xu ordered Cai Mao to open a concealed passage so Jia Xu could enter lightly for a meeting.
texts.贾诩在襄阳嘱蔡瑁守固外城门，以防泄漏并控制进出通道。: In Xiangyang, Jia Xu instructed Cai Mao to securely guard the outer city gate to prevent leaks and to control the access route.
texts.贾诩在襄阳指示蔡瑁，五百伏兵仅作隐蔽护卫与撤退掩护，不得在会面处设伏或主动发动攻: In Xiangyang, Jia Xu instructed Cai Mao that the five hundred ambushers were only to serve as concealed guards and as cover for withdrawal, and must not ambush at the meeting site or initiate an attack.
texts.贾诩在襄阳指示蔡瑁，令一名可信部将在会面地外暗中待命以便护送或掩护。: In Xiangyang, Jia Xu instructed Cai Mao to have one trusted officer wait covertly outside the meeting place to provide escort or cover.
texts.贾诩在襄阳指示蔡瑁，暗探须以折白布一角与暗语“薄礼已备”作为确报张绣着落的信号。: In Xiangyang, Jia Xu instructed Cai Mao that the secret scout must use a folded corner of white cloth and the code phrase 'a small gift has been prepared' as the confirmed signal of Zhang Xiu's whereabouts.
texts.贾诩在襄阳指示蔡瑁，若暗探以约定信号确报张绣着落，贾诩将轻装前往会面地点。: Jia Xu in Xiangyang instructed Cai Mao that if a scout confirms Zhang Xiu's whereabouts with the agreed signal, Jia Xu will travel light to the meeting point.
texts.赵云一行分三批单列静默进入城内。: Zhao Yun's party entered the city silently in three single-file batches.
texts.赵云从三十一人中抽调十二人执行外侧截断与掩护任务。: Zhao Yun detached twelve of the thirty-one to cut off and provide cover on the outer side.
texts.赵云决定：在改为保守侦察并入城暂驻时，他优先保障赵云随从的安全并负责掩护撤退。: Zhao Yun decided: if he switched to conservative reconnaissance and entered the city to temporarily stay, he would prioritize the safety of his followers and be responsible for covering the retreat.
texts.赵云决定：若任一先决条件不满足，他将改为保守侦察并入城暂驻。: Zhao Yun decided: if any prerequisite was not met, he would switch to conservative reconnaissance and enter the city to temporarily stay.
texts.赵云决定：若所有列明先决条件均满足，他将配合张飞实施夜袭，并负责截断退路与掩护撤: Zhao Yun decided: if all listed prerequisites were met, he would cooperate with Zhang Fei in a night raid and be responsible for cutting off escape routes and covering the withdrawal.
texts.赵云向许褚回报：愿按暗号入城并隐蔽驻守。: Zhao Yun reported to Xu Chu: willing to enter the city using the secret signal and remain concealed while stationed.
texts.赵云向许褚回报：目前位置在新野南门外正南三丈处。: Zhao Yun reported to Xu Chu: currently three zhang due south outside Xinye's south gate.
texts.赵云向许褚回报：目前在大槐树东侧数步处待命。: Zhao Yun reported to Xu Chu: currently standing by a few steps east of the great locust tree.
texts.赵云向许褚回报：随行中没有伤员。: Zhao Yun reported to Xu Chu: there are no wounded among the party.
texts.赵云向许褚回报：随行未携带旗帜或火把。: Zhao Yun reported to Xu Chu: the party is not carrying banners or torches.
texts.赵云向许褚回报：随行确切人数三十一人。: Zhao Yun reported to Xu Chu: the exact number accompanying him is thirty-one.
texts.赵云向许褚询问新野当前情势，并寻求可用援兵与部署建议。: Zhao Yun asked Xu Chu about the current situation in Xinye and requested available reinforcements and deployment advice.
texts.赵云命令张嵩、段威、韩广、李靖和周超不携带旗帜或火把并保持压低声息。: Zhao Yun ordered Zhang Song, Duan Wei, Han Guang, Li Jing, and Zhou Chao to carry no banners or torches and to keep their voices low.
texts.赵云命令张嵩、段威、韩广、李靖和周超在看到折布信号或听到低声口令“白云”后再行动: Zhao Yun ordered Zhang Song, Duan Wei, Han Guang, Li Jing, and Zhou Chao to act only after seeing the folded-cloth signal or hearing the low-voice password "White Cloud."
texts.赵云在新野侦查时未发现曹军有大规模列阵，路上仅见零散劫掠与散兵。: While scouting Xinye, Zhao Yun did not find the Cao army in large formations; he only saw scattered pillaging and stragglers on the road.
texts.赵云指挥的其余十九人分三批在大槐树下待命，见暗号后分批入城隐蔽。: The remaining nineteen men under Zhao Yun's command waited under the great locust tree in three batches and, after seeing the secret signal, would enter the city in batches and hide.
texts.赵云整编了十二人负责截断与掩护。: Zhao Yun organized twelve men to be responsible for cutting off and providing cover.
texts.赵云派遣五名亲兵张嵩、段威、韩广、李靖和周超作为先行接应队伍。: Zhao Yun dispatched five personal guards—Zhang Song, Duan Wei, Han Guang, Li Jing, and Zhou Chao—as the advance reception team.
texts.赵云派遣的五名亲兵张嵩、段威、韩广、李靖和周超已经出发。: The five personal guards Zhao Yun sent—Zhang Song, Duan Wei, Han Guang, Li Jing, and Zhou Chao—have departed.
texts.赵云的主力三十一人无伤，在大槐树下待命。: Zhao Yun's main force of thirty-one is uninjured and waiting under the great locust tree.
texts.赵云的先遣五人已就位。: Zhao Yun's five advance men are in position.
texts.赵云负责截断敌军的粮道并掩护我方撤退。: Zhao Yun is responsible for cutting off the enemy army's grain route and covering our side's retreat.
texts.赵云负责截断曹军退路并掩护张飞部队。: Zhao Yun is responsible for cutting off the Cao army's retreat route and covering Zhang Fei's troops.
texts.赵云随行约三十余名亲兵，这些亲兵的主要任务是侦查。: Zhao Yun is accompanied by about thirty personal guards whose primary task is reconnaissance.
texts.这三路轻骑兵分别隐蔽驻陈留、濮阳与博陵渡口待机。: These three detachments of light cavalry are concealed and stationed at Chenliu, Puyang, and the Boling ferry crossing, respectively, on standby.
texts.这三路轻骑兵被要求在日出与日落例行上报侦察回报，并在遇敌时速报。: These three light-cavalry detachments are ordered to report reconnaissance findings routinely at sunrise and sunset and to send rapid reports when encountering the enemy.
texts.这十名精兵预计约十五分钟到达预定位置并就位。: These ten elite soldiers are expected to reach the designated position and take their posts in about fifteen minutes.
texts.进出通行的口令为“新野”，供许褚一行使用。: The password for passing in and out is "Xinye," for Xu Chu and his party to use.
texts.进城主暗号为许褚拍掌三次。: The main secret signal for entering the city is Xu Chu clapping his hands three times.
texts.陈登向曹操通报下邳与徐州的守备情况及可用的内应位置。: Chen Deng informed Cao Cao of the defensive situation in Xiapi and Xu Province and the locations of usable insider contacts.
texts.陈登嘱咐这五名亲信详记曹操军营中的兵力、卫备与哨卡位置。: Chen Deng instructed the five trusted men to record in detail the troop strength, defenses, and sentry/post locations in Cao Cao's camp.
texts.陈登在小沛与曹操面见。: Chen Deng met Cao Cao in Xiaopei.
texts.陈登在小沛对曹操表示愿意成为曹操的内应。: In Xiaopei Chen Deng told Cao Cao he was willing to act as Cao Cao's insider.
texts.陈登在小沛派出五名亲信夜间直奔曹操军营外围。: Chen Deng in Xiaopei sent five trusted men at night straight to the outer perimeter of Cao Cao's camp.
texts.陈登在徐州命令派出三队轻骑在夜间侦察吕布的军情。: Chen Deng in Xuzhou ordered three units of light cavalry to scout Lü Bu's forces at night.
texts.陈登在徐州夜半命令城上弓手将拴有密信的箭射向小沛。: Chen Deng in Xuzhou at midnight ordered the archers on the city walls to shoot arrows with secret letters attached toward Xiaopei.
texts.陈登在徐州连写数封密信，并将这些密信拴在箭上。: Chen Deng in Xuzhou wrote several secret letters and tied them to arrows.
texts.陈登指示这五名亲信向曹操军营方面索取收悉回信或约见的时间地点，并将结果速回报小沛: Chen Deng instructed the five trusted men to obtain from Cao Cao's camp an acknowledgment reply or the time and place for a meeting and to promptly report the result back to Xiaopei.
texts.集合点定在城南门外正南三丈处的大槐树下。: The rendezvous was set under the large locust tree three zhang due south outside the city's south gate.
texts.预定信号的另一用途是通知弩手就位，并准备鸣号同步齐射。: Another purpose of the prearranged signal was to notify the crossbowmen to take their positions and prepare to sound the horn and fire in unison.
texts.预定信号的用途之一是催促轻装拦截小队立刻出动前往发现敌小股的地点。: One purpose of the prearranged signal was to urge the lightly equipped interception squad to immediately move to the location where enemy small forces had been discovered.
texts.马腾在西凉响应密诏，受封征西将军，统领西凉兵起兵出征长安，讨伐李傕与郭汜。: Ma Teng in Xiliang responded to the secret imperial edict, was appointed General Who Conquers the West, and led Xiliang forces to march on Chang'an to attack Li Jue and Guo Si.
